༄༅/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rje bya btang ba sangs rgyas rdo rje dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar ba mdo tsam brjod pa sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan dzasbu chu bo'i gser gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /mkhan shes rab dpal gyis brtsams/

dkar chagadang po/ 'brungs rabs 'ga' zhig rdo rje'i lung gis phye ba'i skabs/ (1)gnyis pa/ rigs rus phun sum tshogs par sku bltam sa pa'i skabs/ (10)gsum pa/ ngur smig gi rgyal mtshan bzhes shing bshes gnyen dam pa du ma las chos kyi bdud rtsi mnos pa sogs gsan sgom ya ma bral bar mdzad pa'i skabs/ (16)bzhi ba/ bstan dgon nyams pa slar gsos shing gdul bya rnams la dbang lung khrid gsum gyi zab chos 'dod rgur stsal ba sogs bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad pa'i skabs/ (40)lnga ba/ dus ngan snyigs ma'i mar gsham du'ang thabs tshul sna tshogs kyi sgo nas 'gro don bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad pa'i skabs/ (70)drug pa/ mjad pa'i tha ma bstan pa dang dgongs rdzogs sogs ji ltar bsgrubs pa'i skabs/ (94)

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/dang po/ zhabrungs rabs 'ga' zhig rdo rje'i lung gis phye ba'i skabs/ ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru badzra dha ra ya/dpal ldan dang po'i sangs rgyas mchog gi dgongs pa'i lha lam rtag rol pa'i/ /zab gsang rdo rje sgrig pa'i man ngag tsha zer 'bum rdzogs rta ljang can/ /gsang chen rlos kyi snang bas skal bzang 'gro ba'i pad tshal bzhad mdzad pa/ /khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dngos dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs pad spyi bos mchod/ /ltar bcas 'gro ba'i mgon po nyi ma'i gnyen/ /rgyal tshab dam pa mi pham chos kyi rje/ /klu sgrub thogs med la sogs 'phags bod kyi/ /rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob na mas la gus phyag 'tshal/ /1

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzesargyan/bsil ldan ljongs su mthar thug dbu ma'i mig 'byed rton pa bzhi ldan che/ /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dgongs don legs bshad gter gyis gsal mdzad sgrol ba'i mgon/ /rnam gnyis mchog gi gsung skyes bu chen gser ri'i phreng ltar rab mdzes pa/ /yab sras rgyud par bcas pa tshe rabs phreng bar gtan gyi skyabs su 'dzin/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i mkhyen rab li khri'i rdul/ /brgyad gnyis langs tshor smin pa'i 'jo sgeg can/ /byams brtses gzigs pa yol med snang ba yis/ /dri med legs bshad 'jo ba'i spobs pa stsol/ /bdag nyid chen po'i gsang gsum yon tan tshogs/ /dpag yas rgya mtsho'i rdul dang mnyam pa la/ /sar gnas 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa 'i〈cog min na/ /blo dman bdag 'dra'i tshul bzhin brjod nus ci/ / 'on kyang blo ldan bskul ba don yod phyir/ /tshur mthong blo yi spyod yul dang 'tsham pa'i/ /ngo mtshar mdzad bzang cha tsam bkod pa yang / /

rnam pa ra thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i ma jes rgyan gzur gnas skye bos dad pa'i gsos su longs/ /de yang srid pa'i bde 'byor thams cad mi gtsang ba'i 'dam rdzab lta bur gzigs nas 'khor ba la rgyab kyi phyogs pa'i nges 'byung gi bsam pas 'di snang gi 'khri ba yongs su bcad de/ lus can mtha' dag 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral ba'i dam bca'i khur bzhes te/ thugs bskyed rlabs po che'i sgo nas dben pa'i ri sul rnams su nyin mchan khor yug tu mdo sngags kyi lam sbyi dang / khyad par dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdzogs rim sbyor ba yan lag drug gi nyams bzhes zab mo la gcig tu gzhol bas yi dam lhag pa'i lhas mngon sum du rjes su bzung zhing 'gyur med bde chen mchog gi rtogs pa klong du gyur pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po/ don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te rdo rje 'chang rje btsun sangs rgyas rdo rje dpal bzang po zhes snyan pa'i ba dan dkar po 'dzam gling yangs pa'i tha gru kun na mngon par g.yo ba 'di ni/'phags mchog phyag na padmo nyid rang cag gi skal ba dang 'tsham par theg pa mchog gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rnam rol du sngon byon skyes chen du ma'i 'gyur med rdo rje'i lung gis yang yang bsngags shing / dam pa rang nyid kyis kyang tshul de 3

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bsta na pa 'i mdzesargyan/ltar zhal bzhes mdzad pa la mi bslu ba'i tshad mar bya 'os pa yin te/'phags pa mchog gi rnam 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang 'dul gyi gdul bya rang rang gi mos blo dang 'tsham par sku'i bkod pa sna tshogs pa'i gzugs kyis chos ston pa'i phyir te/ 'phags mchog pad dkar 'jin pa'i yon tan rgya cher ston pa za ma tog bkod pa'i mdo sde las/ de bzhin gshegs pas 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la ni/de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs kyis chos 'chad/ces dang /de bzhin du rang sangs rgyas dang / dgra bcom pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / mthu bo che dang / tshangs pa dang /dbang po dang / nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / me lha dang / lu lha dang / rlung lha dang / klu dang / bgegs med pa'i bdag po dang / gnod sbyin dang /ngal gsos po dang / rgyal po dang / pha ma rnams la'ang sbyar te/ sems can dag ji lta ji ltar 'dul ba de lta de ltar chos ston to/ /zhes 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gis skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams kyi khams dang bsam pa dang bag la nyal mtha' dag ji bzhin gzigs pa'i sgo nas gang dang gang gis 'dul bar 'altar ba de dang de'i gzugs kyis chos ston zhing rjes su bzung tshul rgya

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/cher gsung pa dang / mi g.yo bla med gtum po'i rgyud las/ gang dang gang gis gzugs kyis ni/ /sems can 'dul bar de nyid 'jug /ces gang la gang 'dul gyi gdul bya rnams kyi khams dbang dang mthun par gzugs sku'i phrin las kyi bkod pa nam yang dus las mi yol bar 'bad med lhun grub tu 'jug rigs pa yin par gsung pa dang /bka' gdams rin po che'i glegs bam las kyang /kye gangs ri'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /gnas de na khyod kyi zhing khams yod/ /zhing de na khyod kyi gdul bya yod/ /ces gangs can sā la'i sman ljongs chen po 'di nyid 'phags mchog pad dkar 'dzin pa'i gdul zhing thun mong ma yin pa lung du bstan pa yin gshis/'phags pa nyid kyis bdag gir mdzad de thog mar mi'i 'gro ba spel ba nas/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po sogs da lta'i bar du byon pa'i rgyal blon mkhas grub gnam gyis sa bkab pa lta bu'i sku'i rgyu 'phrul bzung ste/ yangs pa'i rgyal khams kun du thub bstan rin po che thabs tshul du ma'i sgo nas dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa yin pa'i phyir na de dag gru 'dzin mgon po'i sgyu 'phrul yin min gyi khyad par su zhig gis 'byed mi nus pa'i tshul ni/ kun mkhyen doX

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzesargyan/pe'i zlos gar rje zhwa mar paṇḍi tas/ bsil ldan 'dzin ma'i lte bar sngon byon pa'i/ /lo paṇa mkhas grub de dag phal mo che/ /phyag na parme'i sprul bar ro gcig phyir/ /gang dang dbye ba'i khyad par su yis dpog /ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du 'dzam bu'i gling na che ba'i che mchog grub dbang padma ka ra dang / gangs ljongs bstan 'dzin rnams kyi khrod na thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i ston pa zla med kun mkhyen jo nang ba dang /grub brgya'i 'khor sgyur chen po rje thang stong rgyal po rnams kyi sprul ba'i rol gar yin pa'i tshul yang / sprul ba'i gter chen kun bzang nyi ma'i rnam dag g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing khams kyi mthong snang dri bral me long las/smra phyogs sangs rgyas rdo rjeḥbakra shis blo gros rgya mtshongag dbang ye shes gzhon nuḥgu ru'i rnam 'phrul kho naḥ'abrel tshad rnga yab rir 'godaḥ( ces dam pa gang nyid gu ru'i rnam 'phrul 'khrul med yin pas de

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzesargyan/dang 'brel tshad zangs mdog dpal rir 'dren par gsung pa dang /yang gter chen de nyid kyi padma dbang chen rol ba'i gsang gtam rgyang grags 'od khyim bdun pa las/byang phyogs a khyung bya ba'i grong mtshams nasaḥsbas pa'i rnal 'byor 'khrul zhig bya btang baḥm bcos gsum gyi don rtags 'chang ba yiḥrdo rje'i mtshan can sgo 'di 'phrad gyur naḥdwangs ma 'od lus grub pa'i rten 'brel yodaḥces gnas dang rje nyid kyi yon tan chos kyi che ba bcas gsal bar bstan pa yin la/ de bzhin padma mdo sngags gling pas kyang /rgyal kun phrin las kun 'dus padma 'byung / /dbyer med grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal//da lta'i 'gro ba'i snang ngor dol po'i gar//zhes sogs dang / gter chen padma tshe dbang mchog gis rje btsun byam mgon dang sbyar ba sogs brjod par bya ba mang du yod kyang de tsam mo/ / smras pa/dpal ldan dang po'i sangs rgyas dus 'khor lo'i/ /gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i man ngag mtshor/ /

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzesargyan/dbang sgyur ded dpon grags pa'i ba dan dkar/ /don gnyis lhun grub nor bu'i gling du btsugs/ /khyod thugs 'gyur med bde chen rdo rje nyid/ /gang 'dul cir yang 'char ba'i sgyu 'phrul ni/ /dpag yas zhing du 'gogs med rtag rol bas/ /rab 'byams sprul ba'i zlos gar dpog nus ci/ /de lta na'ang tshad ma'i skyes bu 'gas/ /lung bstan 'gyur med rdo rje'i nyi zer gyis/ /phye ba'i skyes rabs padma dkar po'i phreng / /blo ldan dad pa'i gsos su cha tsam spel/ /las nyon rlabs kyis drangs pa'i lus can kun/ /sna tshogs duḥkhas mnar ba'i srid mtsho las/ /bsgral ba'i snying stobs mchog gi rtser gshegs pa/ /brtse chen snying rje'i rang gzugs pad dkar 'dzin/ /rnam mang bskal bar thugs bskyed rgya mtsho'i mthu/ /bsil ljongs 'gro ba'i dpal du yongs smin pa'i/ /

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/'phur 'gro'i slob dpon padma ka ra zhes/ /grags pa'i ba dan dkar po sa gsum g.yo/ /dri med mkhyen rab gser gyi 'khor lo yis/ /rgyal bstan gling bzhi'i khyon la dbang bsgyur nas/ /nges gsang chos mchog nor bu'i char 'jo ba'i /gangs ljongs chos kyi 'khor bsgyur dol po pa/ /zab gsang bdud rtsi'i bcu da bzang rol ba'i mthus/ /zung 'jug grub pa mchog gi sar gshegs pa'i/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug dpal ldan lcags zam pa/ /grub dbang bye ba'i dbus na mngon par 'phags/ /zhes dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rje bya btang ba sangs rgyas rdo rje dpal bzang po'i na ma par thar ba mdo tsam brjod pa sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan dzaskru chu bo'i gser gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba las 'khrungs rabs 'ga' zhig rdo rje'i lung gis phye ba'i skabs te dang lo// //

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzesargyan/gnyis pa/ rigs rus phun sum tshogs par tho/ bltams pa'i skabs// da ni mtshungs med 'gro ba'i mgon po gang de'i sku dngos kyi mdzad pa'i dbang du byas na mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi sgo nas sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa'i bdag por gyur pa'i rnam par thar ba rgya mtsho lta bu las dad gus ku sha'i rtse mod son pa'i gdung sel bdud rtsi'i thig pa tsam brjod par bya ste/de yang bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid gang du sku bltams pa'i yul ni/ nai pā la'i cho sa rgyal gyis/ bod ces bya ba khyad par 'phags pa'i yul/ /ri mtho sa gtsang gangs ri gnyan gyi mgul//bsil ba mdzes pa lha gnas gzhal med khang //ngo mtshar med byung phan bde 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /chu bo bzhi 'bab rtsi shing nags kyis mdzes/ /'bru sna lnga 'khrungs rin chen sna tshogs 'byung / /zhes bsngags pa'i rol mo dus su 'brol ba'i gnas mchog 'phags mchog phyag na padmo'i thugs rjes nye bar bzung ba'i zhing khams bsil 10

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzesargyan/ldan kha ba dkar po'i sa 'dzin gyi rtse mo mkha' la bsnyegs pa'i phreng ba khor yug tu dngar ba'i byang phyogs bho ṭa'i ljongs de la/ stod dbu gtsang chos kyi chol kha/ bar mdo stod mi'i chol kha/ smad mdo smad rta'i chol kha zhes grags pa'i phyi ma/de la rma klung gser ldan phyug mo 'bab lugs kyis lho byang gnyis su phye ba'i lho rgyud/ srid pa'i lha gnyan chen po rma rgyal spom ra'i sa'i bye brag yul lha'i rgyal po gnyan chen thod pa rtsal gyi pho brang gi lto phyogs/tsung yi ri rgyal phyug mo'i nye zhol/shin tu brjid chags pa'i sa 'dzin gyi phreng bas phyogs mtshams kun nas yongs su 'byud cing ri klung kun tu rtsi shing nags tshal gyi bongs tshod dgung du reg pa'i rtse nas dpyid kyi pho nyas mgrin dbyangs snyan dgur sgrogs pa/ spang ljongs yid du 'ong ba rnams su kha dog rab tu bkra ba'i chu skyes sna tshogs kyis mgo lcog ldem pa/ dwangs bsil 'jum dkar g.yo ba'i klung du gangs sbal mdza' mo'i khyu tshogs kyis rtsed 'ablo'i 'phur lding la rol ba/ gser ldan 'dzin ma'i ngos su 'bru drug snye ma'i lang tsho g.yur du za ba/ sngon byon dam pa du ma'i zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyi rlabs pas bkra shis dge mtshan gyi g.yang chags pa'i gnas ya 'dzi'i sum mdo zhes bya ba'o/ /11

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/gang las 'khrungs pa'i rigs ni/ rus mdzod du/ mi bu rus drug zhing po sgo dang bdun zhes pa las zla rigs su gtogs pa'i smon yin gshis yab mes thams cad blo gros kyi dkyil che zhing rang bzhin drang ba sogs ya rabs kyi spyod tshul ci rigs dang ldan pa/ rus ni rigs ma nyams pa'i pha de'i rgyud las byung ba yin pa dam pa 'gas gsungs shing / rigs rgyud de zam ma chad par byung ba las dus nam zhig gi tshe smon gyi rigs las skyes pa'i bla ma chen po zhig gis yul gru gang sar 'dre gdon gyis gnod pa byung ba dag la mdos chog gi phrin las che ba byung ste/ snyan pa'i grags pa ring du rgyas pas mi tshang de la mdos sang zhes grags so/ /khyim rgyud der byung ba'i mdos tshe po le la bu gnyis yod pa'i che shos ni rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po mdos dbon rgan bstan pa rab gsal yin la/ chung ba mdos tshe mchog ces pa rang bzhin drang la phyi thag ring ba mkhas shing mdzangs la blo brtan pa sogs ya rabs kyi ngang tshul ldan pa de ni dam pa 'di'i yab yin la/ yum ni 'be za rdzogs li zhes bya ba bud med kyi rten la g.yo sgyu chung zhing rtag tu ngo tsha khrel yod kyi gos kyis bklubs pa/ phyag mchod dang bzlas brjod la ngang gis gzhol ba sogs bsngags 12

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/par 'os pa zhig go/ yab yum de gnyis la sras ming sring lnga las rje 'di ni sras 'bring po'i tshul du bsam bzhin sku'i skye ba bzhes so/ /nam 'khrungs pa'i dus ni rab byung bco lnga pa'i bgrang bya so drug pa stod 'grel lugs la dge byed ces pa legs sbyar saṃ sgri ta'i skad du shu bha kri ta ma/hā tsi na'i yul du zhin yin 'bod pa/spor thang 'byung rtsis pa'i chu pho stag gi lo'i dbyar gyi dpal mo'i lang tsho rab tu rgyas pa'i dus tshes dge bar 'od stong bdag po chu 'dzin gyi rgya las grol ba bzhin du/ngo mtshar ba'i dge mtshan gyi ltas du ma dang bcas yum la gnod pa med par khye'u mdog legs shing dpral bar dbyes che ba/ dbang po rnams mchog tu gsal la dwangs pa sogs skye skra gzhan dang mi mthun pa'i mtshan dpe'i lang tsho shin tu gsal ba srid zhi'i/ dge mchan mtha' dag gcig tu spungs ba bzhin blta bas byebyeg mi shes pa zhig mngon par bltams te lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten kun gyi mig gi bdud rtsir gyur to/ /de'i tshe dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha rnams kyi mthus 'gyur khug dbyangs bdun rdzogs pa'i dpyid kyi pho nya sbra'i chon 'gor bab ste mgrin pa'i rgyud mangs spreng ba ni/ khyim gzhis de la rgyal kun byams brtse'i phung po ngur smrig 'dzin pardi

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa 'i mdzesargyan/bshes gnyen mchog gi zlos gar mngon par rtsen te legs bshad dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i dbyangs snyan gyis/ las ldan gyi skye bo yongs kyi snyan dbang bdud rtsi'i bcud len du bsgrubs te smin grol gyi lam la sbyor bar mdzad pa'i dge mtshan yin par mngon no/ / smras pa/gru 'dzin mgon po'i thugs rje'i nyi ma'i 'od/ /srid pa'i mun pa 'phrog pa de srid du/ /cir yang snang ba'i ngo mtshar rtse dga' yis/ /phan bde'i 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i zhing khams 'dir/ /legs smon dpal gyis mtho ba'i yum mchog gi /nyes pa'i skyon bral mngal gyi chu 'dzin las/ /grol ba'i zla tshes gsar bar co 'dri ba'i/ /mtshan ldan khye'u snang bsnyan deng 'dir shad / /de'i tshe dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha yi mthus/ /dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i mgrin rnga 'khrol ba yang / /rnam mang gdul bya'i rna ba'i bcud len du/ /legs bshad 'dod dgu 'jo ba'i ltas su mngon/ /14

rnamapar thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzesargyan/zhes dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rje bya btang ba sangs rgyas rdo rje dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar ba mdo tsam brjod pa sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan dzambha chu bo'i gser gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba las rigs rus phun sum tshogs par sku bltams pa'i skabs te gnyis pa'o/ /

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzesargyan/gsum pa/ ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan bzhes shing nga5ges gnyen dam pa du ma las chos kyi bdud rtsi mnos pa sogs gsan sgom ya ma bral bar mdzad pa'i skabs// de ltar rgyal sras gzhon nu sku bltams pa'i gnas tshul de khu bo dbon rgan rin po che'i gsan par de 'phral dam rdzas dang / srung mdud sogs stsal te byis pa 'di la gtsang sbra gal che tshul gyi rgyu mtshan dang bcas ljags bkod zhib par gnang / gzhon nu de yang dkar gsum sogs mthun pa'i yo spyad kyis gsos shing gces par bskyangs pas sku'i gzi byin rdzing gi padma ltar nyin re bzhin 'phel ba byung ste khyim du gnas pa'i tshe yang / dam pa'i mdzad bzang la 'dres pa'i bag chags sad stobs kyis tha mal gyi byis pa'i spyod pa las ring du 'das te bag yod du gnas pa dang / byis pa gzhan dag dang lci rtsed la rol ba na rtse grogs na mas chos nyan nga/'i chul gyis 'dug

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/bcug ste/ rang nyid kyis chos 'chad pa'i stangs ka dang tsog cog por bsam gtan bsgoms pa'i tshul mdzad pa sogs 'byung 'gyur dang mthun par kun spyod yid du 'ong zhing / skye bo su zhig gis mthong yang dang ba 'dren pa zhig yin stabs drag gzhan thams cad ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su byed pa zhig go /tshul de na/ ji skad du/ du ba las ni mer shes dang / /chu skyar las ni chur shes bzhin/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo ldan gyi//rigs ni mtshan ma dag las shes//zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /dgung lo lnga bzhes pa'i tshe nub gcig gzim mal nas glo bur du sngangs stabs kyis bzhengs te gzim sad pa na a le nga skrag song yang skrag dgos pa zhig mi 'dug phur ba red ces gsungs pa yum sogs nye 'khor na yod pa dag gis gsan zhing / de'i tshe dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i zhal dngos su gzigs shing byin gyis rlabs pas rgyal gdon sogs kyi nyer 'tshe mtha' dag las rgyal ba'i gdeng tshad la mnga' brnyes par mngon la/ phyis su tshul de zhal slob nang ma zhig las thos so /dgung grangs brgyad son pa nas khu bo bstan gsal mchog klog 17

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdze rgyan/slob pa'i slob dpon du bsten nas rang yul la dar cha che ba'i 'don cha mtha' dag bslabs pa tsam gyis dka' tshegs med par thugs su chud/ slob dpon gzhan las kyang yi ge 'bri ba dang dam pa gong ma nas brgyud pa'i rgyud sde rnams kyi phyag len dbyangasarta gar thig soṭa rig pa'i gnas phran du ma dus thung ngu'i tshegs med du mkhyen/ de nas dgung grangs bcu gcig pa yongs 'dzin zhes pa chu pho byi ba'i ston khar tshe rabs du mar legs pa'i mdzad bzang la goms pa'i bag chags kyi mthus khyim na gnas pa ni mi dge ba'i bya ba ngan pa dang / nyes pa mtha' yas pa skyed pa'i las nyon gyi 'chang ba dam pos bcings pa yin pas rnam smin yid mi 'ong 'byin pa'i gnas sprul gdug pa'i tshang dang mtshungs shing / rab tu byung ba ni nyes pa de dag las ldog cing sngon byon dam pa gong ma rnams kyi 'jug ngogs med du byung ba yin pas da ni bdag gis khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ba yang dag par blang bar bya'o snyam du dgongs nas/gtsang chen gong ma'i rdo rje slob dpon brtan mkhas kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa'i gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po kun dga' mkhas grub dbang phyug dpal bzang po rang dgon du phebs pa'i 18

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/drung du rab byung dang dge tshul bsgrubs te zhi bsil thar ba mchog gi khang bzang du legs par zhugs pa'i dga' ston gyi thog ma shar nas mtshan la sangs rgyas rdo rje zhes gsol/ de nas bzung sku tshe hril por sha chang sogs log 'tsho'i rigs dang / dad gshin gyi rdzas la dug bzhin 'dzem pa dang srung sdom khas blangs pa la dpa' ba tsam ma yin par spang blang gi gnas rnams zhib tu nges par byas te/ blang dor tshul bzhin du byas pas sdom brtson dam pa rnams kyi gtsug rgyan du gyur/de dus rang dgon gyi bla grwa yongs la rab kha rdo rje 'chang nas rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dkyil 'khor zhe brgyad kyi zab dbang rim par stsal ba'ang gsan/mjug tu blo sbyong don bdun ma dang rgyal sras lag len sogs kyi zhib khrid las brtsam pa'i gsungs bshad rgyas pa gang gnang thams cad gus pa chen pos ma g.yeng bar yid la bzung zhing nyams len la gcig tu gzhol bas rgyud thog tu khel ba byung / byis su dge rtse'i gnas nang bzhugs pa'i tshe nye gnas la khong gi zhal nas/rang lo bcu gnyis son pa nas bdag bas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che sngags lam dang 'brel ba'i nyams len gyi gtso bor bzung ste bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis da lta kho po'i lus 19

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzesargyan/ngag yid gsum 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sku gsung thugs rnam par dag pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig las tha mal gyi snang ba ldog tshul sogs snod bcud kyi snang ba dag pa'i rnam rol du gzigs pa/'i nyams rtogs klong du gyur ba'i stobs kyis dgyes pa'i nyams sba ma nus pa'i zol gyis bka' mchid gnang ba yin la/dgung grangs bcu gsum nas bcu drug la sleb pa'i bar khu bo dbon rgan rin po che sogs dam pa 'ga' zhig las zab chos ci rigs gsan zhing gang gsan pa thams cad kha phyi ltas su ma song bar rang rgyud 'dul ba'i gnyen po kho nar lag len la btab pas 'di snang gi zhen pa chod nas sgrub pa nyams len la brtson pa'i shugs bla lhag tu 'phel ba byung /de nas dgung grangs bcu bdun pa dus kyi pho nya zhes pa sa rta'i lor dam pa gang gi 'di snyam du dgongs te/ spyir theg pa gsum gyis bsdus pa'i legs tshogs thams cad bla ma la ltos shing khyad par gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i myur lam gyis snyigs dus tshe thung gcig la zung 'jug gi sku lag rtser 'gug pa ni mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rag las shing / de yang bla ma sangs rgyas dngos 20

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/su mthong ba'i mos gus kho na la ltos pa yin pa'i nges shes ldog tu med pa byung /tshul de ni sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud las/slob dpon ji ltar blta zhe na/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /de nyid rtag tu rdo rje 'chang / /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen tog /de nyid ye shes rgya mtsho ste/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen sbyin/ /slob dpon gyi ni yon tan bzung / /skyon ni nam yang ma yin no/ /yon tan bzung na dngos grub cing / /skyon rnams kyis ni dngos grub nyams/ /de yi grib ma'ang mi 'goms te//mchod rten bshig dang 'dra bar gsungs//zhes dang /rin chen bang mdzod las/ skyon bral yon tan rdzogs pa'i bla ma ni/ /snyigs ma'i dus na sangs rgyas dngos dang mtshungs/ /rab dang sri zhu gus pa'i spyi bor bsten/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa klu sgrub gyis/ slob dpon gyis ni sdig pa 'phrog /slob dpon gyis ni 'jigs pa sel/ /slob dpon gyis ni sdug bsngal gyi/ /rgya mtsho'i 'jings las sgrol bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / dam pa gong ma'i gsung sgros su'ang / bla ma sangs rgyas su shes pa'i mos gus dang / /ci mdzad yon tan du mthong ba'i dad pa dang / /bsam rgyu bla ma las med pa'i gdung sems gsum/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs 'dod na med thabs med/ /ces gsungs 21

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa ri 4 dzes rgyan/pa ltar yin pas de dag gi dgongs don mtha' dag thugs nyams su bstar te/ rigs kun 'khor lo'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang bstan pa rab gsal mchog dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i zab gsang lam gyi de nyid ston pa'i do rje slob dpon du bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten pa yin gshis bdag nyid chen po des kyang dam pa 'di skal ba dang ldan pa'i rdo rje'i slob ma mchog tu gzigs nas thugs brtse bas rjes su bzung ste/ chos mched dam pa ka thog byang chub rdo rje/ khra phag lo sogs dang mnyam du zab lam rdo rje rnal 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug gi thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro chos bdun du grags pa der bla mas ji ltar gdams pa bzhin gakhog tu 'grus pas skyabs 'gro'i skabs rang gzhan mtha' dag srid zhi'i 'jigs pa las skyobs pa'i skyabs yul dam pa mchog gsum kho na yin par yid ches brtan po rnyed pa dang / sems bskyed kyi tshe sems bskyed spel byed tshad med bzhi'i gnad tshang ba'i sgo nas gzhan don du rdzogs byang thob 'dod kyi sems bskyed rnal ma skyes pa dang / rdor sems sgom bzlas kyi skabs thog med nas bsags pa'i nyes lhung gi dri ma ci rigs re dag pa'i mtshan ma nyams dang rmi 22

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/lam du byung ba dang / maṇḍal gyi tshe dngos 'byor yid sprul gyi mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho lta bu'i bsod nams kyi phung po de zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor myur du rang rgyud du skye ba'i lhan cig byed rkyen gyi rgyur song ba dang / bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs bka' drin gsum ldan gyi rdo rje slob dpon de nyid sangs rgyas dngos mthong gi mos gus nyams pa med pa'i ngang dbang bzhi'i byin rlabs rgyud la 'phos pa dang / dus 'khor lhan skyes kyi tshe dag rdzogs smin gsum tshang ba'i bskyed rim lha'i rnal 'byor gyis rang lus lha'i 'du shes 'phos pa tsam gyi tshad du sleb pa byung ba dang / mchog dbang khyad par can gyi skabs shes rgyud gsang chen zab mo'i mngon rtogs skye rung du smin pa dang / dben sems kyi tshe sems kyi gnas 'gyu rig gsum ngos zin zhing g.yo thob goms brtan mthar phyin pa'i nyams byung ba la brten nas sems btang sdod la dbang thob pa sogs gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos shin tu mang stabs rdzogs rim ye shes myur du skye sla bar gyur to/ /de nas dngos gzhi sor sdud kyi rnal 'byor la 'jug pa'i tshe rang lugs kyi dam pa gong ma dag gi snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'i man ngag zab mo rnams rje btsun bla ma mchog gi zhal nas legs par gsan te 23

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa re mdzes rgyan/nyams su blangs pa'i tshul ni/ bsdus pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las/ nam mkhar kun nas zhen pa'i sems dang mig ni mi 'jum do rje'i lam du rab tu zhugs pa yis/ /stong pa la ni du ba smig rgyu rab gsal dri ma med pa'i mkha' snang nyid dang mar me dang / /'bar ba dang ni zla ba nyi ma rdo rje rnams dang mchog gi cha dang thig le mthong bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rlung 'ching ba'i lus gnad dang bcas te smin mtshams nas sor bcu drug gzhal ba'i steng gi nam mkha' la yid mig rlung gsum g.yo med du lhan gyis gnas par byas te/ bsam med kyi rnal 'byor la gtso bor mnyam par bzhag ste bsgoms pa'i stobs kyi chos nyid rnam pa thams cad pa'i rang gzugs 'od gsal rtags bcu'i snang ba 'byamathe klas pa nyin mtshan 'khor yug tu mched cing / de yang zhi ba lha'i rdo rje'i klu las/ rmad byung nam mkha'i dkyil shar bhu su ku /stong nyid gzugs mdzes shar ro bhu su ku /nges med me tog shar ro bhu su ku /rin thang med pa'i me tog rin chen longs/ /zhes gasdo/ngas pa bzhin yin la/dam pa gang nyid sor sdud kyi smad tsam la sleb pa'i tshe 'od gsal rtags bcu'i phyi ma thig le sngon po yung 'bru tsam gyi dbus su 24

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa 'i mdzes rgyan/re khā nag po skra'i tshad la thub pa gtso 'khor gsum ma 'dres shing shin tu gsal bar snang ba yod par glang bla mkhas mchog la gsungs pa yin zhing / tshul de ni rgyud kyi rgyal po las/ nam mkha' chu 'dzin bral ba dag ni rnal 'byor pa yi bgrad pa'i mig gis blta bar bya ba ste/ re khā nag po dri med 'od zer 'phro ba dus kyi rtsa la mthong ba'i bar du'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sor sdud kyi ye shes mtshan nyid pa rgyud la skyes par mngon no/ /de nas bla ma dam pa'i man ngag bzhin bsam gtan gyi rnal 'byor bsgoms pas 'od gsal rtags bcu'i snang ba ci dgar du 'char ba la dbang thob pa'i bsam gtan gyi yan lag lnga po rim bzhin rjes mthun pa'i nyams gsal po re byung ba yin te/ rgyud las/ bsam gtan dag kyang shes rab rtog dang dpyod pa dga' dang g.yo med bde ba rtse gcig sems pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de nas srog rtsol gyi skabs su rdor bzlas dang bum can gyi sbyor bas srog thur gnyis lte ba'i dbu mar ro gcig tu bcings pa la mnyam par bzhag pas ro rkyang la brten pa'i rlung bcu'i rgyu ba rags pa ci rigs dbu mar thim pas stong srog dbyer med kyi snang ba 25

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan rab 'byams zhu bde khyad par ba'i ngo bor mthong thub pa byung ste/ rgyud kyi rgyal po las/srog rtsol dag kyang lam ni gnyis po brgyel zhing dbu mar srog ni rab tu zhugs pa dag tu 'gyur / /zhes gsungs pa'i gnad dang mthun no/ /skabs 'dir yang khong gi rgyud la srog rtsol gyi nyams rjes mthun pa skye bar the tshom med de/ phyis su 'brog dge 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab rgya mtsho la rtogs 'bul zhus tshe srog rtsol dngos gzhi'i nyams kyi ngo sprad pa yin la/ tshul de rjes nas zhib tu 'chad/ 'jin pa'i skabs gnas drug gi bum can snga phyi'i sbyor bas mi shigs pa'i thig le drug la rlung sems dbyer med ro gcig tu bstim pa'i rnal 'byor la brtson pa lhur bzhes gnang ba dang /rjes dran gyi skabs rlung sbyor dang bcas sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi'i 'khrul 'khor la brten nas thig le dbab bzlog bkram gsum brtan pa'i thabs la gcig tu 'grus pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor la'ang gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa'i mos pa lam byed kyi tshul dam pa gong ma'i phyag srol ji lta ba bzhin nyams bzhes mtha' 'byol bar mdzad pa sogs zab lam rdo rje rnal 'byor sbyor 26

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/ba yan lag drug gi mthar stan thog gcig ma 'pho ba bcas lo gsum du brtson pa drag po chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bsten pas gsang chen zab mo'i nyams rtogs mtha' dag dam pa gang gi thugs rgyud la spungs pa bzhin byung nge pha/ /de ltar sngon goms bzang po'i bag chags kyi mthu brtas pas rje 'di nyid sku na phra ba'i dus nas bka' gdams gong ma'i brtul zhugs kyis sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i dmigs rkyen du 'gyur ba zhig bya snyam pa'i thugs 'dun rang chas su yod stabs dgung grangs nyer gcig pa chu khyi'i lor khu bo dbon rgan rin po che'i drung nas ni gu chos drug sogs shangs chos skor gyi dbang lung man ngag rnams bum pa gang byos tshul gyis gsan te/lo hril por sgrub pa la rtse gcig tu gzhol bas nyams len gnad du thon pa byung ste gtum mo 'bar 'dzag gi snang ba sogs sngar las ches cher 'phel ba byung /de rjes sgrub gnas de nyid du lo gsum gyi ring gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i rim gnyis zab mo'i nyams bzhes gtso bor mdzad cing /de yang bsags sbyang dang sprel na gnad du 'gro bar dgongs te/thun gseng dag tu phyag 'tshal ba dang / swā tstsha gdab pa rdor sems sgom bzlas sogs 27

rnam par thar bsgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mjis rgyan/tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong gi rim pa'ang phal ba'i blor mi shong ba'i tshod tsam gnang ngo / /tshul de la khu bo dbon rgan tshang thugs rab tu ma nyes pa byung ste zhal nas khyed kyi da lta nang bzhin sgrub pa la gcig tu gzhol ba de shin du legs/'on kyang sku na gzhon pa'i dus thos bsam byed pa'ang ches gal chen yin pas da dung shar 'dzam thang phyogs su phebs nas yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po ngag dbang tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i zhabs la gtugs te slob gnyer dbyis phyin pa zhig byed thub na kho bo'i blo bde ba yin zhes nang bcar gyi bslab bya gnad smin stsal bas dam pa nyid kyang 'phral du phebs 'dun thugs la 'khrungs te bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i dam bca' phul/de nas dgung grangs nyer lnga pa me stag lor blo grags dang khang bso gnyis sdeb bzhin chos sde chen po dpal 'dzam thang bsam 'grub nor bu'i gling du phebs nas mkhas grub bye ba'i gcug rgyan snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa rje ngag dbang tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i dgyes zhal mjal ba tsam gyis smra mi shes pa'i spro ba dang dad gus tshad med 'khrungs/ rje bla ma mchog gis kyang thugs shin du brtse ba'i 28

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/nyams kyis bshad sgrub la sbyang ba ji ltar mdzad tshul las brtsam pa'i dri rmed sogs bka' mchid mang du 'phel/ de skabs bshes gnyen 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis gzhung chen du ma la bshad pa zhib rgyas su gnang ba'i skabs yin gshis/ dbon phun tshogs dang rdo ra bla ma blo chos sogs rnam dpyod kyi rtsal dang ldan pa dag dang lhan gcig tu 'ba' mda' thub bstan dge legs rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i bsdus grwa'i spyi don rin chen sgron me dang / de'i zur dpyad nyin byed snang ba gnyis tshar gcig gsan pa'i tshe yang dpal ldan chos kyi grags pa'i rigs pa'i gnad gsang ma lus pa thugs su chud pas 11gas sde snod 'dzin pa rnams kyis bsngags pa'i me tog dus su 'thor ba byung /de nas phar phyin gsan pa'i thugs bzhed che ba byung ba ltar bdag nyid chen po 'di'i spyan sngar mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel ba yum don gsal ba'i me long dang 'grel ba don gsal dag yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dang sbyar nas mtha' chod pa'i gsung bshad zhib rgyas su 355 ba dag legs par gsan te/gzhud tshan re la'ang sbyangs ba mi dman pa mdzad stabs mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi gzhung don la go ba gting tshugs shing de nyinā

rnam ri rsā tharab rgyu ba rgyud ngacan pa 'i ma dzes rgyal dri ma med pa'i rigs pas mtha' cho da par byas te pha rol du phyin pa'i lam gyi grangs dang go rim sogs la nges shes gting nas rnyed pa byung /de yang thos lo dang sbyangs lo tsam du bzhag pa ma yin par lo ngo mthong bzhi'i bar du nyen mtshan khor yug tu dpe gzigs rgyun chags su gnang ste/thos don rgyud la sbyor ba'i nyams bzhes la rtse gcig tu brtson pa yin no/ /de nas dgung grangs nyer brgyad pa sa sprul lor rang yul du phebs te bzhugs pa'i tshe 'be'i shes rab kyi mos 'dod bzhin khong gi bu chung la klog slob pa'i slob dpon du thog ma'i rten 'brel gang legs bsgrigs pa rbershags kyis re ba bskangs/ dus 'di tsam nas skye bo drag zhan thams cad kyis mdos dbon chung zhes bka' gdams rnam thar gtsang ma'i brtul zhugs las mi 'da' ba'i spyod lam legs pa'i tshad du 'jog pa byung ngo / /dgung grangs nyer dgu pa lcags rta'i lor slar yang 'dzam thang du phebs te/ rje ngag dbang tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i drung nas lam rim spyod 'jug sa 'grel sbyor drug spyi don nā ro'i spyi don/ blo sbyong don bdun ma/rtsis dkar nag gso ba rig pa'i skor sogs la nang 30

rnam pa ra thang ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa 'i mjes rgyan/byan chud nga ra mdzad/dgung grangs sum cu pa lcags lug gi lo smad nas dar lnga'i ri khrod du phebs/ 'dzam dngos rdo rje 'chang gi drung du mjal bar thugs mnyes pa'i gsung mchid mang du stsal ba'i lhongs shig la mdang nub kho bo'i mnal lam du 'od dkar po thig le'i dbyibs can zhig shar ba rmis pas de ni sangs lo khyod kyis sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa la phan thogs pa'i rtags su 'dug ces 'byung 'gyur gzigs pa'i gsung yid la bcang par 'os pa mang du gnang /de nas dam pa de nyid kyi mdun nas a skyong sprul sku lung rig rgya mtsho dang / nga dge kun rgyam sogs dang mnyam du/ mthong don/ sgom rim/ sbyor drug phyi nang gi ngo sprod/ bskyed rim zung 'jug snye ma/'jigs byed snyan rgyud sogs bskyed rim dag gi mngon rtogs kyi ljags khrid/ nyid kyi mjad pa'i gcod kyi lus sbyin sogs kyi khrid lung / rlung bcos gegs sel bogs 'don sogs la drogs gcod dang bcas gsan sbyang dpyis phyin par mdzad/dgung grangs so gsum pa shing khyi'i lor rdo grub dgon gtsang chen dngos grub dpal 'bar gling du byon/ yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes 31

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyudabasta na pa'i mdzes rgyan gnyen chen po klu shul mkhan blo bzang phun tshogs mchog gis/gnas 'go bla ma/ kya la mkhan po chos mchog grwa lag mkhan 'od ldan/ lha bzo bla ma dam chos sogs rdo 'dzi smra gsum gyi gsan mkhan sum brgya lhag la yon tan rin po che'i mdzod kyi 'grel ba rdo grub rgan gyis mdzad pa'i sgo lcags 'byed byed bsdus 'grel rgya mtsho'i chu thig rin chen sde mig gi steng nas gzab khrid rgyas pa zla ba gsum gyi bar du gnang ba'ang legs par gsan pas gzhung don yongs la thugs nges 'drongs shing zin bris kyang mdzad/nyen zhig khong gi gsung 'phros su chos gang gsan thams cad dpe thog tu mi 'jog par rang rgyud 'dul ba'i gnyen po kho nar lag len btab na chos ci tsam thos pa de tsam/ rang rgyud je dag sgrib pa je srab/ lus ngag gi spyod pa je dul/ srid 'byor /spru zhen pa je chung du 'gro dgos mod/ 'on te kho pos dka' las 'di tsam mjad kyang khyed tshos thos don rgyud la sbyor rgyu ma red gsungs nas spyan chab chod dka' ba byung bas thams cad ci bya gtol med la gtug de'i rkyen gyis dam pa gang gi thugs la skyo ba shugs drag skyes te/ ci nas kyang rje nyid kyi gsung pa bzhin byed dgos snyam nas dam bca' brtan po 32

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bsta na pa'i mdzes rgyan/mjad/rjes su gsung de nam dran tshe dge sbyor la bskul ba'i gdams pa zab mo zhig 'dug ces gsungs/dgung grangs so lnga pa me byi'i lor thub pa'i bstan pa snga dar gyi mjug tu sleb pa na dbang phyogs tsi na'i yul nas dmag gi dpung tshogs sa'i dreg pa lta bu rgyang bskyod byas stabs bstan 'gro'i legs tshogs mtha' dag rim gyis nyams 'grib byung ba la nye ba'i tshe yul 'dir yang dus log gi zing cha che bas dam pa khong kyang rang gnas su bzhugs nus ma byung bas hor zla lnga ba'i nang khu bo dbon rgan rin po che'i zhabs phyi zhus te/ a skyong sbra gsar tshang gi sa thog tu bros byol la phebs dgos byung / phebs lam du kya kya zhes pa'i rgan mo shin du nyam thag pa zhig chur lhung nas 'jigs skrag dang sdug bsngal gyis gdung ba'i skabs su khel bas de la snying rje chen po skye ba'i dbang gis 'phral du rgan mo de chu klung las bton te/ rang gi nab bzas g.yogs shing chibs rta la bskyon pa sogs gces skyong tshad med mdzad pas lam grogs rnams ha las te bla ma zhes pa de mdos dbon chung lta bu zhig dgos zhes yang yang bsngags brjod kyis dus 'da' ba byung / dbyar smad du khu bo rdo rje 'chang grib skyon lta bus sku snunā

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/tshabs chen bzhes pas khong gis phyag rdzas gtos che ba sman dang rim gro'i phyogs su btang nas zhabs brtan phon cher bsgrubs kyang sku snyun dwangs skyed ma byung bar sa stag lo'i dpyid khar sku tshe'i 'phen pa btang ste bsam bzhin zhi dbyings su gshegs chul bstan/ de nas thugs dam grol ba'i rtags byung ba'i skabs dang bstun sku gdung la longs sku'i chas 'jug phul te/ 'du khang gi steng du ser phreng gis spyan drangs te me la zhugs 'bul gyi tshe reng bsrel dpag tu med pa byung / dgung zhag gi bar dam pa gang gi thugs kyi bzhed dgongs yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir dge rtsa rgya cher bsgrubs/ston khar ma pu'u hphang gis mā te hrin dmag dpung dang bcas mgo log phyogs su btang nas dmag dpung gar sleb kyi dgon grong thams cad me la bsregs stabs yar thang dgon pa'ang de'i zhar la rtsa brlag tu song / dus der ma chi'i dmag gi gdug rtsub chen pos rong 'brog dgon gsum du gnas pa'i skye bo ji snyed cig gi rgyu nor yod rgu phyogs shing bsad bzung ci rigs byas pas shul du lus pa'i mi rnams kyang gson po me dung du tshud pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba la gzigs shing gsan pas/ thugs la shas mi bzod pa'i 34

rnam nga ra thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan rī 'i rme jes rgyan snying rje tshad med pa zhig 'khrungs te dbul zhing 'phongs pa dag la phyag tu ci 'byor ba'i longs spyod kyi stob cing dus chos su gyur ba rnams la'ang gshin chog dang 'pho lung sogs gang la gang 'dod kyi re ba bskangs so//tshul de ni bden pa chen po'i le'u las/nad dang mya ngan na ma pa mang dag gis/ /shin du gtses pa'i skye rgu nyon mongs rnams/ /gzigs nas sdug bsngal ma lus bsal slad du/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i thugs rje rab tu skye/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dang /gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las/ mya ngan zug rngus gdungs pa la/ /dbugs 'byin byed pa phan pa'i mchog /ces mya ngan gyis gzir ba'i sems can rnams kyi mya ngan bsal ba ni byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mchog tu gsungs pa dang / rgyal sras zhi ba lhas kyang / mya ngan nyam thag dga' thob shog /yi chad rnams kyang yid gsos shog/ces smon pa bzhin bdag nyid chen po 'dis kyang de ltar mdzad pa yin no/ /dgun sleb pa'i mtshams su thub dbang stobs bcu mnga' ba'i zhal rkyen rje ngag dbang tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i drung du byon nas khu bo sogs kyi ched du bsngo rten phul te skyabs 'jug zhus/ sngar gsaspya

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzesargyan/pa'i zab chos dag la drogs gcod gang yod zhus te re zhig 'dzam thang du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ glang 'bud mkhan ngag dbang bstan 'dzin nyid ched gnyer gyis 'dzam thang du byon/ je ngag dbang tshogs gnyis pa'i mdun du lha dar che legs phul te mjal 'jom zhus/thugs nang gshin pa'i gsung gleng mang tsam mdzad mthar mkhan rin po che nas da lta yar thang dgon pa'i mdos dbon rgan dag zhing du gshegs pas thun pa na mas kha thor du song ba dang /dgon pa'i 'du khang sogs rgya dmag gis rgyab gtor bsregs gsum byas te mi ro las lha ros gtsog pa lta bu'i gnas su lhung yod pas khyed kyi mdos dbon chung la dgon sde skyong dgos pa'i ljags bkod cig stsal rgyu ni shin du mkho ba'i skabs yin gshis/ de lugs thugs la bsnams dgos zhes thre/ mtshan zhib tu zhus par bab bstun gyi zhal bzhes gang legs gnang /nyin gcig dam pa gang nyid ri khrod gang 'gol zhig tu phebs 'dun thugs la 'khrungs te 'phral du rje bla ma'i drung du kho bo mi 'gyang bar g.yi khog bya bral ba'i mdun nas sngar ma gsan pa'i gdams pa ci rigs gsan te dben gnas nges med cig tu sgrub pa rnam dag byed 'dod yod tshul zhus tshe/ rje bla ma dam pa'i zhal nas/ de yang 36

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/shin du legs mod/ 'on kyang yar thang dgon pa ches nyam thag tu gyur yod stabs dgon pa'i ban chung rnams kyi mgo 'dren gang nus mdzod de bstan dgon skyong dgos chul gyi zhal bkod lhu thing ba stsal ba dang / de mtshungs mthong don dang srid du ring ba'i lha rdzas nang mjod bcas gtad de rdo rje slob dpon du mnga' gsol mjad/ dus tshes dge ba'i nyin rje nyid la thon phyag zhus te phyir rang gi gdan sar myur stabs kyi phebs pas yul 'di'i skye dgu rnams la dge legs 'od stong 'bar ba'i chos kyi nyi gzhon gsar du shar ba'i rten 'byung gi sgo thog mar byung ba yin no/ / smras pa/srid pa'i tsha gdung 'phrog pa'i 'od dkar can/ /lang tsho'i 'phel ba ma rdzogs tshes kyi dus/ /lhan skyes 'dzum dkar g.yo ba'i rtse dga' yang / /cher snyigs rgud pa bcil ba'i byed por grub/ /zhi bsil mchog la 'dun pa'i nges 'byung gis/ /'khor ba'i srin mor mdza' ba rab btang ste/ /ngur smrig gos bzang 'chang ba'i brtul zhugs mchog /tshangs spyod skye bo yongs kyi dpal du gyur/ / 37

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa 'i mdzes rgyan/rig 'dzin chen po'i lung gis bsngags pa'i gnas/ /mar gad zhun ma brtsegs 'dra'i sa 'dzin spor/ /'du 'dzis dben pa'i rang shong spyil bu mā /rdzogs rim nyams bzhes zab mo'i gter sgo phyes/ /kun rtog snyog ma dwangs pa'i 'od gsal ngor/ /rab 'byam sa rtags bcu'i snang ba yongs 'phos pas/ /rdul bral rnam pa kun ldan stong ba'i gzugs/ /'gyur med bde ba'i gar dang lhan cig rtsen/ /med byung rno gsal shes rab gru bo che/ /gus rtag brtson pa'i ba dan cher g.yo bas/ /rab 'byams gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i 'jings brgal te/ /thub bstan rin chen gling mchog mnga' dbang bsgyur/ /de'i tshe rigs kun 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gis/ /rgyal tshab ded dpon mchog tu dbang bskur nas/ /nges gsang zab mo'i man ngag nor bu'i mdzod/ /rnam mang gdul byar stsol zhes dbugs dbyung mdzad/ /38

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mjes rgyan/zhes dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rje bya btang ba sangs rgyas rdo rje dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar ba mdo tsam brjod pa sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan dzasbu chu bo'i gser gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba las ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan bzhes shing bshes gnyen dam pa du ma las chos kyi bdud rtsi mnos pa sogs gsan sgom ya ma bral bar mdzad pa'i skabs te gsum pa'o/ /

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzesargyan/bzhi ba/ bstan dgon nyams pa slar gsos shing gdul bya rnams la dbang lung khrid gsum gyi zab chos 'dod rgur stsal ba sogs bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad pa'i skabs/7/ de nas dgung grangs so brgyad pa myos ldan zhes pa sa yos lor thog mar gzhan don mdzad pa'i phrin las kyis sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa ji ltar bskyangs ba'i tshul yang /ji skad du mdo las/rgya mtsho chu srin rnams kyi gnas/ /dus las yol bar 'gyur srid kyang / /gdul bar bya ba'i sems can la//thub pa dus las yol mi 'gyur//zhes gsungs pa bzhin bshes gnyen dam pa'i zhal gdams snying la bcing ba dang dam pa rang gis kyang ring nas yid la brnag pa'i thugs bskyed dus su smin pa gnyis stabs gcig tu byung ste/ thabs 40

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa 'i mdzes rgyan/la mkhas pa'i mdzad bzang brgya phrag gi sgo nas 'dul bar 'os pa'i lus can mtha' dag la ris su ma chad par 'jug pa'i phrin las kyi snang ba rgya mtsho'i rlabs ltar dus las yol ba mi mnga' ba'i rten 'brel zab mo'i gnad kyis dam pa khong gi mnal lam du gdan sa'i 'khor lo mang po zhig 'gyel 'dug pa de yar bslengs te bskor ba rmis pa'i dge mtshan dag la brten nas sgrub grwa bsam gtan gling gi rdo rje slob dpon gyi khur bzhes te/dpal dus kyi 'bor lo'i zab lam rdo rje rnal 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug gi rim gnyis zab mo'i chos mdzod kyi sgo legs par phyes nas thog mar sbyor drug ba/ 'phags pa/ gsal bzang / rig dpal/tshul bzang / ngag bka smon rgyam na mas la sbyor ba yan lag drug gi dbang lung man ngag gi sgo rgya cher spel/ de dang dus mtshungs sgrub sde 'og ma la'ang shangs chos ni gu chos drug sogs kyi dbang lung ljags khrid sogs rang rang dang 'tshams pa'i chos bka' ci rigs gnang /gzhan yul sde'i drag gras dag gi re zhus bzhin dgon 'di'i lha sder gtogs pa'i skye bo yongs la bsnyung gnas kyi sdom lung stsal te dpal sprul sngon 'gro'i ljags khrid sogs so so'i 'dod pa ltar 41

rnam pas thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/zab rgyas chos kyi bdud rtsi char du bsnyil bas mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi sgo 'phar yongs su phyes/ rgya sprul ngag dbang bstan 'dzin pas mchod rten rnams nyams gso byed pa'i skabs su khong gis zung 'jug gang dgos thams cad rten rnams la chog gzhung ltar phul ba sogs chos ldan gyi bya ba 'gang chen mtha' dag gi khur legs par bzhes/ lo 'dir dgon gong ma'i thun khang rnams rgya dmag gis gtor bshigs btang ba'i rkyen gyis sbyor drug ba dag kyang dgon 'og mar 'dug cing lo rjes mar bre li pos sgrub khang zhig ral du song yod pa rnams zhig gso bgyis te legs par grub pa na chos tshan dang po'i sbyor drug pa rnams yar spor du bcugadagung grangs so dgu pa rnam gnon zhes pa lcags 'brug gi lor sbyor drug ba tshul rgyam/ bre li po sogs drug ste de dag la chos bka' zab mo dus su gang babs legs par stsal/snon zla'i nang dus mthar rgyal ba'i dam chos 'dzin pa la thugs bskyed med du byung ba yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun ngag dbang tshogs gnyis rgya mcho'i sku snyun bzhes tshul gsan ma thag myur stabs kyis ra shug ri khrod du phebs/ thugs sras bu chen dag dang mnyam du sman dang zhabs 42

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/brtan nyin mtshan sprel te bsgrubs kyang phan skyed ma byung bar hor zla drug pa'i tshes bco brgyad kyi nyin seṅge nyal stabs kyis dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim tshul bstan pas thugs skyo che ba'i ngang dngos 'byor yod dgus dgongs mchod rgya cher bgyis shing dgung zhag gi bar thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs pa'i thabs gang zab bsgrubs/de nas phyir rang gi gdan sar phebs te thun pa rnams sngar bzhin bskyangs/dgung grangs bzhi bcu pa khyu mchog ces pa lcags sprul lor sbyor drug ba gsar 'dug med kyang chos tshan snga phyi gnyis la dus 'khor mchog dbang dang / bla mchod/ mi zhabrugs pa/ lha dgu gtor bsngos rnams kyi ljags lung stsal/dgung grangs zhe gcig pa sna tshogs zhes pa chu rta lor sprul sku bshad sgrub dpal dang bstan nor sku mched 'dzi ska nas tshur slebs pa'i thugs bzhed dang bsdun sor sdud sogs kyi gdams pa gang zab gnang zhing lugs gnyis kyi bslab ston zhib rgyas kyang stsal/spyir dam pa 'di nyid sku na phra mo'i dus nas dben gnas gang rung zhig tu gsang chen zab mo'i nyams len gyi gnad ma 'byugs pa'i sgo nas mi 43

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa 'i ma jes rgyan/tshe sgrub pa la skyel rgyu'i thugs 'dun nar mar yod na'ang lo 'dir rgya sprul btagags stabs dgon gzhi nyams pa slar gso ma thub pas khang sar dpon dpal ris dang dgon grong gi skye bo mchog dman thams cad kyi blo sems gcig dril gyis bla ma rin po che gshin chog sogs su phebs te 'bul nod byung ba gang dag gsar du bskos pa'i las sne chos 'phel/sman lha/khang bso/'gur brtan/dpal bzang rnams kyi phyag tu sprad nas 'du khang nang gi lha ris dang / mchod rten dag gi 'geb sogs nyams rgud thebs pa'i rten rnams slar gso dgos pa'i zhu nan phul ba bzhin byed dgos byung /dgung grangs zhe gnyis pa nyi ma zhes pa chu lug la sbyor drug pa 'phe'i tshul/ 'phags pa/ ngag rgyam ste gsum la zab lam rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi gdams pa dus su gang babs gnang /dgungs grangs zhe gsum pa nyi sgrol byed ces pa shing sprel lor sbyor drug pa sher bzang / thugs mchog ngag byams rnams la sngon 'gro 'bum lnga'i dmigs khrid dang / dngos gzhi'i thun pa sogs chos tshan snga phyi dag la dus 'khor mchog dbang / bla mchod/ gtor bsngo'i/rta mgrin/ phur ba/ phyag rdor rnams kyi ljags lung gnang /44

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan rī re ma rdzes rgyan/dgung grangs zhe bzhi pa sa skyong zhes pa shing bya la sbyor drug pa kurma/rig rgyam sogs bzhi la zab lam rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi zab khrid dang /thun gseng dag tu zhal slob rnams la dbang lung zab khrid ci rigs stsal zhing / khyad par sprul bshad sgrub dpal dang bla ma byang rdor zung gi thugs bzhed bzhin 'jam pa'i dbyangs thub bstan dge legs rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i rdzogs rim sbyor ba yan lag drug gi sgom rim gyi dmigs khrid zhib cing rgyas pa gnang /dgung grangs zhe lnga pa mi bzad ces pa me khyi'i lor sbyor drug pa sangs phun/ lung rigs/ mtshan ldan te gsum la dbang dang gdams pa gang dgos dus su legs par stsal/ lo snga phyi ci rigs su skar rgyam/ don gsal/ tshul bzang / rnams kyis zhus ngor spyod 'jug sa 'grel chen mo'i gzab bshad dang / rje'i lam rim dang / 'ba' mda'i lam rim myong khrid bla ma gong ma'i gsungs rgyun dang 'brel lung rigs kyis rgyan pa'i gsungs bshad rgyas pa dang / de las brtsams te dge sdig blang dor gyi tshul la gzob pa lhur len dgos pa'i bslab 'doms go sla zhing gnad 'dril ba'i bka' drin stsal/dgung grangs zhe drug pa thams cad 'dul zhes pa me phag la sbyozlo

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzesargyan/drug pa gsar 'dug med kyang dngos gzhi'i thun pa sogs la dus 'khor mchog dbang dang / gtor chog bla mchod/ sgrol ma dmar mo sogs kyi ljags lung gnang /dgung grangs zhe bdun pa kun 'jin zhes pa sa byi'i lor sbyor drug pa bla ma 'phags pa/ gsal bzang /phun tshogs/ sman mchog rnams la sngon 'gro 'bum lnga'i dmigs khrid legs par stsal te 'bum lnga rdzogs pa'i je sa su chos mtshams mdzad/dgung grangs zhe brgyad pa 'gal ba zhes pa sa glang 31ra nges gsang bstan pa kho na thugs la bcings te dam pa gong ma nas brgyud pa'i dbang lung zab khrid kyi rgyun nyag phra bar gyur ba dag spel ba'i thugs 'dun bzlog med zhabrungs stabs hor zla dgu ba'i nang dam pa khong la bla ma 'phags pa dang / gsal bzang gnyis kyis zhabs phyi byas te/ thog mar rnga stod rtsi nang dgon du phebs/ rtogs pa'i dbang phyug chen po rje mtshan bzang nyid dang mjal 'dzom zhus shing dam par 'os pa'i bka' mchid mang du 'phel/ dus tshes dge ba'i nyin rje de nyid kyi drung nas phyag na pakhro'i rnam sprul bla ma mkhas bzang sogs dang lhan du dus 'khor dbang mo che dang / bde mchog rab 'byams kyi dbang yongs rdzogs legs par gsan/ bar gseng du bla 46

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa 'i mdzes rgyan/ma kun rgyam gyi thugs bzhed ltar bla ma mkhas bzang dang mkhan shes rab sogs don gnyer can 'ga' la 'dzi rgar gter chen rdo rje drag po rtsal gyi dgongs gter sgrol ma dmar mo'i gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang phul/de nas bse dgon thub bstan phyogs rgyal gling du phebs te lha khang so so'i nang rten khag la mchod mjal rgyas par mdzad/bse mkhar sogs bla sprul che gras dag la dngul dang gos 'phrug gis mtshon dngos gtsang ba'i rten 'byung gi 'bul ba spam mtho ba phul te mjal 'phrad gnang bar gsol ston rgyas pas bsnyen bkur dang / rten sgam dag las zhabs drung dang kong sprul rin po che'i phyag nas brgyud pa'i bdud rtsi stong rdo sogs dam rdzas myong grol khyad 'phags dang ring bsrel sogs byin rten du ma'i dngos skyes bdag rkyen zab pa byung /hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig nyin khong dpon slob rnams 'brog dge dgon du chibs btegs/ phyi nyin dben gnas zung 'jug mkha' spyod du 'brog dge'i mchog sprul 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab rgya mtshor mjal kha zhus tshe/ lha rdzas nang mdzod sogs dngos 'bul spus gtsang ba'i tshan grangs mang po dang bcas te/mchog sprul nyid nas nged cag gi sngar ma gsan pa'i dpal ldan rgyal 47

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzesargyan/ba jo nang ba'i dbang lung man ngag rjes gnang sogs dkon pa'i chos rgyun ji snyed cig lo 'di dang phyi ma gnyis la gnang dgos tshul gyi rgyu mtshan zhib tu zhus par/ mchog sprul nyid thugs shin du mnyes pa'i zhal bzhes bzang 21'i bka' lan stsal/ zhabs gras dag gis kyang gzhi'i len bkur bzos chen pos gsol ja dkar spro'i thog thug nang gshin pa'i gsung gleng tsam gyis thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa byung / de ni sngon gyi sku 'phreng du mar bstan 'gror gcig tu smin pa'i thugs bskyed dang smon lam rlabs po ches phan tshun lu gu rgyud du 'brel ba'i bag chags sad stobs kyis yin la/ tshes gsum nas bzung ste gangs ljongs mkhas grub phal mo che'i ljags rtser ma thon pa'i ri chos nges don rgya mtsho la bshad pa zhib rgyas dang / gzhan kun mkhyen chen po'i bka' 'bum du bzhugs so cog gi ljags lung / rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog gi zab khrid brgya rtsa brgyad las thog mar sa skya'i zhen pa bzhi bral nas phyag rdzogs nor bu mthong grol gyi bar re re bzhin bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang 'brel ba'i chos kyi 'byung khungs rnams sngon du btang / dam tshig rdo rje'i sgom bzlas dang so so'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dag skabs dang sbyar te/ dang po 48

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i rma dzesargyan/khrid/ gnyis pa shar sgom/ gsum pa rgyab brten lung dang bcas sum khrid dang / rjes smon lam dang bkra shis kyis mtha' rgyan par byas te nyin re la chos thun gnyis chags med dang / chos thun re la'ang khrid tshan che ba rnams gcig nas gsum bar dang / chung ba rnams gsum nas bdun bar du gang bder byas te/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba bla ma mchod pa dang bka' srung dag la mchod gtor 'bul ba sogs brgyud ldan gong ma'i phyag len ngos gtsang ba bzhin gsan sbyangs dpyis phyin pa gnang / mjug tu jo nang lugs kyi grub chen brgyad cu'i byin rlabs dbang /phur ba 'khon lugs stod las dang smad las drag po'i bsgral dbang / ye shes mgon po dra da lcam dral dbang gnyos lugs su grags pa chos tshan pod gnyis kyi lung / gcod dbang nam mkha' sgo 'byed/ gnad don snying po'i zab khrid/ 'don chog po ti gcig gi lung / chos skyong bag rtse lcam sring gi srog dbang / thang stong lugs kyi tshe dbang rnams legs par gsan/ 'di res 'brog dge'i mchog sprul rin po ches khong gi gdan sa'i sbyor drug pa sogs bka' slob yongs la bla ma sangs rgyas rdo rje ni srog gzugs 'grub pa'i grub brnyes chen po yin gshis rtogs 'bul zhu dgos pa'i gsung gi 49

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i ma dzes rgyan/phebs sgo gnang ba ltar khong gi drung du bla ser bgres gzhon thams cad nyams rtogs ngo sprad pa'i phyir zam ma chad par 'ong ba rnams la so so'i rgyud tshod dang mthun par khong gi nyams myong dang zab lam rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi man ngag zab mo'i gnad gsang gcig tu sbyar te stsal bas rtogs ldan dag gi yid kyi brtan pa rang dbang med par 'phrog ste lus kyi ba spu ldang zhing mig nas mchi ma 'khrugs pa byung /nyin gcig sprul sku rin po che'i gzim shag tu gsol ston rgyas pa'i steng rnam gnyis thugs nyams spro ba'i ngang gsung mchid mang du gnang ba'i skabs shig dam pa nyid nas khyed kyi bka' slob phal cher sor bsam rjes mthun pa'i nyams bzang po re skyes pa kho nar 'dug ces gsungs/ de ltar zla ba ngo mthong gnyis su dbang lung man ngag gis mtshon zab chos mang du gsan pas thugs kyi bzhed don yongs su grub pa byung ngo/ /phyir phebs khar dngos 'bul mtshon tsam gyis thon phyag zhus te thugs 'phreng nyams dang bcas dam pa gang nyid nor bu lon pa'i ded dpon bzhin rang gi gdan sar chibs bskyod gnang /50

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/dgung grangs zhe dgu pa rnam 'gyur zhes pa lcags stag lo'i gral tshes dge ba'i nyin gsal bzang / phun tshogs sogs bzhi la sngar gyi khrid mtshams nas sbyor drug gi rgyun bskyang du bcug hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu bdun nyin 'brog dge dgon du mchog sprul rin po che dpon slob rnams phebs bsu zhu mi rdzong brda' dang / yar mar gyi dgon khag so so'i lha sde dang bcas par chibs bsu ji ltar bya ba'i ljags bkod sogs dbang gi mgo brtsam pa nas mjug ma rdzogs bar gang ci'i 'gro song sogs bya ba yod tshad kyi gtso 'gan bzhes/ phebs bsu zhu mi rnams nyi shu drug la 'brog dge dgon du 'byor/ hor zla bzhi ba'i tshes gcig nyin 'brog dge dpon slob rnams phebs bsu dang bcas chibs gral rgyas tsam byas te glang chen dal 'gros kyis phebs/ mdzo mo'i khyung nyag tu sleb skabs gnyan po g.yu rtse'i rdza ri'i phyogs nas 'ja' sprin ngo mtshar ba byung nas char zim babs pas yul lha'i rgyal pos chibs bsu gnang ba'i rtags su 'dug ces grags/ tshes bzhi'i snga dro rje nyid kyis dbu mdzad de yar thang rgya dgon/ bu tsa/ sgo mang / pan nag 'be tsa dgon te dgon khag lnga'i bla sprul las sne rnams dam pa khong gi zhabs phyir 'brang ste rdzi 51

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mjes rgyan/stod nas mchog sprul rin po che 'byor phyag zhus pas thugs dgyes pa'i bka' 'dri mang tsam gnang / tshes lnga'i snga dror gza' skar 'phrod sbyor phun sum tshogs pa dang bstun nges don rtag brtan bshad sgrub 'phel rgyas gling gi tshoms chen chos khri chen mor gdan drangs te/thog ma'i rten 'byung gi dngos 'bul dang bcas da lan mchog sprul 'gro ba'i mgon po dgon 'dir chibs bsgyur gnang ba ni rang re jo nang pa'i bstan pa rgyas pa'i rten 'brel gyi gnad dam pa yin tshul las brtsams te 'brel chags pa'i zhu 'bul bsdus tsam dang / de rjes bla sprul ser skya so sos mjal dar phul/ tshes drug dang bdun la spang ljongs su gzim gur phub pa la sku ngal gso dgos pa'i snyan sgron phul/tshes brgyad nas sa chog sogs la mthun rkyen gang 'os bsgrubs/'di skabs phyogs nye ring thams cad kyi dgon pa grub chen/ dpal yul/ lung dkar/ lung skya'i chos sgar/ khang gsar/ mdo thog sa bswe dgon sogs dgon dang sgrub sde sum bcu lhag nas phebs pa'i bla sprul brgyar nye ba tsam la bud shing sogs nyer mkho'i rigs gang dgos thams cad dgon pa'i las sne dag la bsgrubs dgos pa'i bkod khyab gnang /32

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan go 'i mdzes rgyan/de nas dus kye 'khor lo'i dbang bskur mchog la 'jug pa'i dus la gtugs te/ dus phun sum tshogs pa sa ga zla ba'i dus chen sum 'dzom gyi nya dang sbyar zhing / gnas phun sum tshogs pa dpal ldan grub pa'i gnas mchog cha bsags rig pa 'dzin pa'i zhing gnyis pa nges don rtag brtan bshad sgrub 'phel rgyas gling chen por/ston pa phun sum tshogs pa 'jam mgon tā ra nā tha de nyid slar yang ljongs 'dir sprul ba'i zlos gar du bsgyur ba mchog sprul thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab rgya mtsho dpal bzang po nyid/ bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis dang de nyid rnam pa bcu drug gi bdag nyid/ sku dag pa rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mo/ thugs dag pa mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo'i sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi bdag por bzhengs te/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa rje nyid kyis gtsos lung rtogs kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i bla sprul brgyar nye ba/ sdom gsum gces par bsrungs pa'i rab byung stong phrag tsam/ dad gus kyis nye bar brgyan pa'i khyim pa ya rabs kyi rigs can stong phrag drug tu brgal ba da~X

rnam pa ra thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa 'i mdzes rgyan/lhan du/ chos phun sum tshogs pa rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal po dpal dus kyi 'bor lo'i dbang bskur zab mo sngon 'gro slob ma rjes 'dzin sta gon gyi rim pa dag dang / bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi dang 'brel ba'i bskyed rim sgom pa la dbang bar byed pa byis pa ltar 'jug pa'i dbang bdun/ rdzogs rim rnal 'byor yan lag drug sgom pa la dbang bar byed pa mchog dbang gong ma/mchog dbang khyad par can/rdo rje slob dpon bdag po dang bdag chen bcas sngon byon gong ma'i phyag bzhes ji lta ba bzhin smin rgyas rna/ 455 ba legs par gsan pas thugs kyi yol go byin rlabs bdud rtse'i bcud bzang gis yongs su gtam par gyur/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag po chen po'i skabs rje nyid dang / sprul skubashad sgrub dpal/ a mkhar sprul sku 'gro phan rgya mtsho/ka thog mkhan po/rgyal sras pad lo/'be tsa bla ma/chos skor bla ma/ bla ma 'od dpa'/ dge sprul/ 'dzam thang mkhan po/ dom tsa sprul sku/ dpal yul sprul sku thub pa/ grub chen mkhan po rnams dbang stegs su 'god pa'i phyag len mdzad/ mjug tu dam pa khong gis bskul ngor shambha la'i smon lam smon 'dod yid bzhin 'grub pa'i shing rta zhes pa gsar rtsom mdzad de ljags lung kyang stsal/ tshes bco 54

rnam nga/ra thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/lnga'i snga dro nas bzung bar gseng dag tu sprul sku bshad sgrub dpal dang 'gro phan gyis gtsos dge chul slong sgrub mkhan nyis brgya lhag byung ba rnams la mthun rkyen gang dgos khong gis sbyar/ 'di res nyin re bzhin nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyis gang zhing dgon pa'i nye 'dabs thams cad du sngar med pa'i me tog rigs mi 'dra ba mang du 'khrungs pas skye bo drag zhan thams cad kyis yab sras thugs bskyed dus su smin pa'i ltas bzang yin zhes gleng mol byed pa byung /zla de'i nyi shu gcig nas rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i bka' 'bum las byung ba'i rgyud sde rab 'byams las/ thog mar ma rgyud skor la bde mchog nag po pa dang lū drel gnyis/ bsdus rgyud rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor/bde mchog 'khrul spongs/ me dri bcu gsum/ rdo rje rnal 'byor yum dkar ma/ sdom 'byung rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor/ sbyang ba'i yon tan/'khor lo bsgyur drug 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ drag po phyag 'bum bong bu'i zhal can/ mchog sbyin rdo rje phag mo lha bcu gsum mar/ bshad rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ phag gdong chen mo/dril bu lha lnga/ khro bo rdor sems/ rdo rje phag mo 'byung ba/ zhi ba rdor sems te bde mchog skor dang / rgyu 'dzul lha lnga/ rdo rje gdanā

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bsta napare mjes rgyan/bzhi/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ nā ro mkha' spyod/phag mo don grub/ rje btsun dbu bcad ma/ rngon pa'i rdo rje phag mo/ gu ru lho phyogs pa'i lugs kyi rdo rje phag mo/ dgyes pa rdo rje/ sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi dbang dang / pha rgyud skor la/ rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags skor lugs gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs/ gshed dmar lha lnga/ dgra nag ro lang brgyad skor/ 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum mar/ gshed dmar lha bcu gsum ma/ dgra nag rwa lugs/gshin rje gdong druga'ajigs byed skyo lugs/ khro mo brgyad skor/ lha zhe dgu ma/ mal lugs lha dgu'ajam dpal gsang ldan lugs/rgyud sde lnga pa/ kun rigami 'khrugs pa/ phyag rdor/ 'khor chen/ dpal rdo rje gtum po/ mi g.yo bla med/phur dbang bdud 'jom rol ba'i stod las dang smad las drag po'i bsgral dbang / bka' srung rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ gzungs grwa lnga'i dbang /rdo rje sems dpa'i bzlas lung /gtso 'dus dbang /grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang / sgrub thabs rin 'byung las byung ba'i rjes gnang gcig gis lhag pa'i sum brgya rnams byin rlabs dang bcas pa/ba ri brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang yongs su rdzogs pa/ tshe chog bdud rtsi'i chu 56

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan rī 'i mdzes rgyan/gter sogs chos bka' ches mang po bka' drin du stsal ba rnams legs par gsan/dgon pa'i drag gras rnams kyis gsol ba btab pa bzhin dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i nyin bdun gyi sgrub mchod bstan pa nam gnas kyi bar du yab sras dgongs bsdur gyis spyi bla zhig lo gsum re la gsar du bsko bzhag gnang / spyir rgyal bstan rin po che'i gzhi ma so thar gyi sdom pa la rag las pa yin gshis gang na dam pa'i chos 'dul ba gnas pa de na rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che gnas shing / gang na dam pa'i chos 'dul ba med pa de na rgyal ba'i bstan pa mi 'byung ba yang rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel te med na mi 'byung ba'i dngos po'i chos nyid yin phyir skabs 'di nas bzung phyogs 'di'i dgon pa dang sgrub sde so sor dbyar gnas tshugs te/ 'dul ba gzhi gsum gyi phyag len rnam par dag pa'i srol dar rgyas su byung ba ni yab sras zung gi thugs bskyed rlabs po che dus su smin pa'i 'bras rtags yin par 'khums so/ /hor zla bdun pa'i tshes gcig la dbang gi mjug legs par rdzogs shing / tshes lnga nas nyin gsum bar khong rnam gnyis g.yang sgrub kyi dbu bzhugs gnang / tshes brgyad kyi nyin dbang dang rjes 57

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa 'i ma dzes rgyan/gnang sogs legs par grub pa'i dga' ston du 'brog dge'i mchog sprul nyid tshogs chen gyi khri la gdan drangs te/ dgon nga/'i bla sprul dang las sne rgyas 'dzom gyi thog rje nyid kyis/ sku gsung thugs rten/ na bza' nyer spyad / dngul ṭaṃ stong phrag lhag mar zhun/ rta nor lnga bcu sogs kyis mtshon ngos gtsang ba'i 'bul nod spam mtho ba du ma spyan lam du bstad zhing / srid na ring ba'i rab dkar lha rdzas dri bral phyag tu bsnams nas/ mchog sprul nyid kyis nges don snying po'i bstan pa 'ba' zhig yangs pa'i rgyal khamasakun tu mi nub yun ring gnas phyir dpal ldan jo nang ba'i dbang lung man ngag je sa gnang sogs dkon pa'i chos rgyun mtha' dag lhug par stsol ba'i bka' drin ni gzhal bar dka' ba yin tshul/ slad nas kyang bstan 'gro'i mgon du zhabs pad g.yo ba med par brtan par bzhugs dgos pa'i zhu nan bla ma'i thugs rje 'khul nges pa phul bas mchog sprul rdo rje 'chang gi thugs shin du mnyes pa'i zhal bzhes bzang po stsal/tshes bcu'i nyin 'brog dge'i mchog sprul dpon slob rang yul du chibs bsgyur gnang bar dam pa khong gis gtsos ser skya brgya phrag mang pos tsha lam tsam du chibs skyel zhus te 'bral mi phod pa'i ngang 58

rnam pa ra thar ba sgrub rgyud bsta na pa 'i mdzes rgyan/phyir rang gi gzim shag tu phebs/ston smad du sbyor drug pa sprul byang chub dpal/ kun dga'/ ngag smon/ smon lam ste bzhi la sngon 'gro chos bdun sogs kyi ljags khrid gnang / dgung grangs lnga bcu pa bong bu zhes pa lcags yos lor sbyor drug pa bla ma e mgon/ sangs rgyam/ pad chul rnams la spyor ba yan lag drug gi byin rlabs don brgyud rnams rim par stsal/lo snga phyi 'di dag tu shangs ba bka' brgyud pa'i zab chos ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ni gu'i dgongs bcud zab bka' byin rlabs kyi shugs ches myur ba'i shepal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rdzogs rim zab mo'i chos drug gi man ngag la brten nas lo gcig tu nyams bzhes mdzad mkhan 'phel 'dzi bla ma tshul rgyam/ bla ma 'phags pa sogs dang jo btsun yang 'ga' re byung ba rnams la dbang lung zab khrid ci dgos dus thog tu stsal ste legs par bskyangs/dgung grangs nga gcig pa dga' ba zhes pa chu 'brug la sbyor drug pa gsar 'dug med kyang dngos gzhi'i chos tshan sogs la chos bka' ci rigs dang / bla ma stong gsal la rta mgrin mngon rtogs kyi dmigs khrid gnang ste bcad rgya dam por dgos pa'i thugs 59

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa 'i mdzes rgyan/bkod gnang /dgung grangs nga gnyis pa rnam rgyal zhes pa chu sprul lor sgo mang a rka bla ma'i gzim shag tu sku mtshams la bzhugs pa'i tshe yul de'i gzhi bdag gnyan mo ke war gyis bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa byas shing lo phyi ma'ang 'dir bzhugs na ci gsung bka' bzhin bsgrub pa'i g.yar dam phul zhes sku tsha a kya la gsungs/dgung grangs nga gsum pa rgyal ba zhes pa shing rta'i lor sku bsnyun cung zad bzhes pa'i nub gcig bla ma rin po che byon te mchil lham zhig gnang ba'i mtshan rmis byung ba la 'dir ma bzhugs zhes pa'i brda ru dgongs te/dus tshes dge ba'i nyin chos thun so sor zab khrid gang dgos stsal zhing gsal 'debs kyi rigs bla ma 'phags pa'i byed dgos pa'i ljags bkod gnang nas spen ma'i sgrub phug tu byon te mtshams la yun ring bzhugs/ thun gseng rnams kun mkhyen dol bu pa dang chos rje mi pham pa'i yig cha la gzigs rtog mdzad pas gzhung don mtha' dag thugs su chud cing khyad par bden gnyis kyi rnam bzhag la nges shes sngar las lhag pa 'khrungs/ skabs 'ga' zhig sgrub khang 60

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i ma dzes rgyan/gi phyi rol tu skyo sangs mdzad pa'i tshe nyin re bzhin nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i gseb nas dung dang rgya gling gi skad sing sing grags shing dri bzang po'i ngad shugs phyogs kun 'thul ba ni dkar phyogs la dad pa'i gnas bdag mi ma yin rnams kyis dam pa khong la bsnyen bkur gyi mtshan ma yin pa'i tshul sku tsha padma gsal la bka' mchid gnang ba'i lhungs su byung zhing / nub gcig gnas lugs 'od gsal la 'byams pa'i ngor bar snang thams cad 'ja' 'od thig le rab tu 'khrigs pa'i klong nas dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis dgyes pa'i glu gar sna tshogs kyi mchod pas stob cing khyad par du de las mtshar sdug 'od du chags pa'i bud med dmar mo dgyes 'dzum bzhad pa'i nyams can zhig gi phyag tu rin po che'i za ma tog lta bu'i snod du ro phun sum tshogs pa'i bza' bca'i rigs mi 'dra ba mang po phul te/ rje nyid 'dir yun ring bzhugs dang nyams rtogs 'phel zhing sbrul sogs kyis 'jigs pa mi 'byung zhes lung bstan pa'i mur mi snang bar yal/ de nas bzung khong bzhugs ring ma zad gnas de la skye bo rgyu 'grul byed pa su zhig gis kyang sprul mthong ba med gshis gnas bdag gis thugs 'dun 61

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/bsgrub pa'i rtags su mngon zhing / rdzong gter kun bzang nyi mas kyang rdo rje phag mo'i gnas yin par gsung pa de don la gnas zhes phyis su gus phran sku mdun du bcar skabs gsungs pa dang /lo der zhal slob nang ma stong gsal dang phun tshogs gnyis nas gsol zas gang 'tshams phul te mjal kha zhus par thugs mnyes pa'i gsung zur gyi rnam pas tshul de bka' mchid gnang ba yin la/der bzhugs ring gling 'bud dgon pa'i ser skya drag zhan mang po mjal du 'ongs bar chos 'brel sogs 'dod mos bzhin gnang /ston khar khang bso dang dpal bzang sogs dgon pa'i dge 'dun yongs nas gsol ba btab pa bzhin ma 'gyang bar rang gi gdan sar phebs/ lo der sbyor drug pa 'jigs sangs/ 'jigs dbang sogs lnga la sbyor ba yan lag drug gi ljags khrid stsal/lo snga ma nas sprul bshad sgrub dpal khong gi khrid rogs su bskos yod pas rgyun du sku khams mi bde ba de yang sangs dwangs su ma song bar yul lha bkra shis dkar 'dzom gyi gnas su zla kha shas mtshams la bzhugs/ nyin gcig bla ma stong gsal gro chas nyung tsam khur te sku drung du bcar ba'i tshe thugs dgyes bzhin gnas gsum mkha' 'gros 62

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan rī 'i ma nge sa rgyan gnang ba'i 'od 'tsher ba'i bya rgyal rgod kyi thes phran lta bu du ma mthong yul du gyur pa'i bka' drin bskyangs/dgung grangs nga bzhi pa myos byed ces pa shing lug lo'i dbyar thog tu sngar nas gra sgrig yod pa bzhin rtsi nang dgon pa'i rdo rje slob dpon skyabs mgon mtshan bzang rin po che rang dgon du phebs pa'i drung nas slob dpon a bhya ka ra'i dkyil chog rdo rje'i phreng ba dang / kri ya sbrags pa'i dkyil 'khor zhe lnga'i dbang / grub mchog mi dra dzo zhi'i thugs bcud mi dra brgya rtsar grags pa'i dbang / mgon po khro bcu'i dbang /gcod dbang nam mkha' sgo 'byed/khros ma lha dgurnam 'jom khro nag gi dbang / grub rgyal lugs kyi che dbang lha gcig bum gcig sogs zab chos mtha' yas pa gsan/ lo 'dir sbyor drug pa chos skyabs/ ngag rig rbershags lnga/dgung grangs nga lnga pa gdong ngan zhes pa me sprel lo'i hor zla bzhi ba'i nang sprul sku dam pa bshad sgrub dpal dang khong rnam gnyis zhabs phyi ba 'ga' dang bcas te 'brog dge dgon du chibs bskyod gnang /dben gnas zung 'jug mkha' spyod du mchog sprul kun dga' 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab rgya mtsho dang mjal 'dzom zhus par thugs 63

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bsta na pa re mjes rgyan/nang gshin pa'i gsung gleng mang du 'phel/ rje nyid kyi thugs bzhed ltar 'brog sprul mchog nas rje bcun rin po che'i khrid yig ma bu bdun gyi gzab bshad zhib rgyas su sru la ba rnams legs par gsan/rje nyid kyi thugs nyams kyi rtogs pa'i chad dang mthun par ngo sprad pa'i chul yang 'di sta ste/ dam pa khong ni sor bsam mthar phyin te srog rtsol gyi dngos gzhi'i nyams skyes shing mnyam bzhag tu srog gzugs dbu ma kho nar thim pas snang grags thams cad bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi rol ba las shar zhing mngon shes drug la thogs pa med/ rjes thob tu gzung 'dzin gyi snang ba tsam skye yang srog gzugs 'grub stobs kyis rang sar dag pa yin gshis ched du spang blang mi dgos/ thun slong gi dngos grub chu la mi byang / brag la mi thog pa sogs rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs la dbang thob kyang dus dbang gis sbas tshul kho na gnang ba las grub bsnyes kyi spyod pa mi mdzad pas nyams khrid mdzad na de 'drar dgos zhes mkhar sprul shes rab chos 'phel sogs bka' slob yongs la dgos pa'i dbang gis thog mtha' bar gsum du gsungs so/ /mchog sprul nyid kyi thugs 'dun ltar rje nyid nas 'ba' mda' 64

rnam pa ra thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa 'i rme jes rgyan thub bstan dge legs rgya mtshos mjad pa'i sbyor ba yan lag drug bi sgom rim/ rta mgrin 'byung 'dul gnyis kyi mngon rtogs sogs khrid yig 'ga' zhig gi bklag lung phul/ 'brog dge'i grwa btsun 'ga' la bla ma lnga bcu pa'i ljags khrid stsal/mchog sprul nyid kyi sku sring mtsho yag dus chos su gyur ba'i sar gdan drangs ba bzhin phebs te khrus chog sogs thugs dam spyan dmigs gnad smin gnang / bzhed don thams cad yongs su grub mtshams mchog sprul nyid la thon phyag zhus te/ rang yul du chibs bsgyur gnang ste rnga yul brgyud nas rang gi gdan sar phyag phebs/lo 'dir sprul sku bstan nor/ bla ma e mgon/ phun tshogs sogs brgyad la khang dmar phung lnga'i bshad khrid shin tu rgyas pa nyin mang por stsal/ ston mjug tu sbyor drug pa sprul sher grags/ 'jigs rab/ kun gsal sogs la zab lam rdo rje na la 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug gi sngon 'gro'i chos bdun gyi lhags khrid stsal/dgung grangs nga drug pa gser 'phyang zhes pa me bya lo'i hor zla dang po'i nang chos skyabs nas sku mdun du zhabs phyi zhus pa'i tshe khong gi zhal nas/ mdang nged kyi mnal lam du me tog sna chogs kyis gang 65

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa 'i ske dzes rgyan/ba'i skyed tshal yid du 'ong ba zhig na glegs bam kha shas 'dug par rmis pas rjes sor bshad grwa'i gzhi tshugs pa'i rtags yin pa 'dra zhebasdo gadza/ngas/hor zla drug pa'i smad du gcang chen gong ma'i rdo rje slob dpon ngag dbang dkon mchog bstan pa dar rgyas kyis ljags bkod stsal ba ltar yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po ngag dbang blo bzang phrin las mchog bshad grwa rgyun chags su 'byung ba'i phyir sngar nas phebs yod pa'i drung nas bla grwa ches mang ba dang lhan du 'jam pa'i dbyangs thub bstan dge legs rgya mtshos mjad pa'i rta mgrin gzhung khrid kyi steng nas lung rigs kyi mtha' chod pa'i gsung bshad rgyas pa nyin du mar gnang ba'ang legs par gsan/ bshes gnyen mchog gi thugs bzhed ltar rje nyid nas rta phyag khyung gsum gyi rjes gnang sdo 05/ston smad du bshes gnyen chen po rang yul tu chibs bsgyur la nye ba'i tshe phebs rdzong du rta sogs 'bul nod gzab shing / ma 'gyang bar rang dgon du phebs dgos pa'i bskul ma gnang / lo 'dir sbyor spyag ba rta mgren/ mchog ldan sogs bdun/ sprin bzang zla ba'i

rnam pa ra thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan skabs shig byams brtse'i gter chen 'be tsa bla ma sku mdun du phebs/nab bza'i cha rkyen du 'bri zhig phul te gsung gleng zhib rgyas gnang /lo snga mar gyang sprul rin po che'ang dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdzogs rim zab mo'i man ngag nod phyir rje nyid kyi drung du phebs pa la mthong sgom zung gi thog nas dpal ldan jo nang pa'i byin rlabs don brgyud kyi man ngag zab mo rnams rjen char du byung ste phul bas rgyang sprul nyid kyang thugs yid shin du tshim pa'i rnam pa mdzad ces grags so/ /sbyo/thaṭa pa/rmad byung thugs bskyed 'od stong drwa ba can/ /skye rgu'i legs byas mkha' la 'phags pa'i tshe/ /byams brtse'i tsha zer 'bar ba'i 'od rlabs kyis/ /'gro ba'i phan bde'i pad tshal ci yang bzhad/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i sa 'dzin rtser/ /nang du yang dag 'jog pa'i skal bzang tshogs/ /dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i zab chos kyi/ /'chi med bdud rtsi snying gi bcud du spel/ /67

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/lnga bdo'i 'gro la brtse ba'i lhag bsam gyis/ /dus kyi zhugs la sbyangs ba'i rten dag kyang / /byin rlabs gzi 'od 'bar ba'i gter chen por/ /gsar du bskrun zhing spel ba dbyar mtsho bzhin/ /rnga yul gser ldan 'dzin ma'i stod smad du/ /zhabs mthil bkra shis re khā nyer bkod nas/ /nges gsang mdzod la dbang 'byor rnam gnyis las/ /zab gsang bdud rtsi'i dga' ston thog mar rol/ /mkhyen rab rgya mtsho mtshan bzang zhabs te bstan pa'i snang byed nyi zla zung / /snga phyir gling 'di'i cho sa kyi khri la zhabs sen mngon par dkod pa las/ /rin 'byung la sogs dkon pa'i chos rgyun ji snyed bdag gis mjad pa yis/ mtha' dbus kun nas ngang gis 'du ba'i thar 'dod bye ba'i re ba skong / /mdor na sgrub la gcig tu gzhol ba'i mthus/ /nyams dang rtogs pa'i dpal gyis mngon mtho bas /chen po'i sar skyes bstan 'dzin phal mo che'i /68

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/kun gyi mngon par btud pa'i gnas su gyur/ /zhes dkyil 'bor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rje bya btang ba sangs rgyas rdo rje dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar ba mdo cam brjod pa sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan dzaskru chu bo'i gser gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba las bstan dgon nyams pa slar gsos shing gdul bya rnams la dbang lung khrid gsum gyi zab chos 'dod rgur stsal ba sogs bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad pa'i skabs te bzhi ba'o/ /

rnam rtepar thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/lnga ba/ dus ngan snyigs ma'i mar gsham du'ang thabs tshul sna tshogs kyi sgo nas 'gro don bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad pa'i skabs/tsho/ dgung grangs nga bdun pa rnam 'phyang zhes pa sa khyi lor yangs pa'i rgyal khams la spyod pa'i skye rgu rnams las ngan gyi bag chasas mthug po'i rnam smin mi zad pa 'i 'bras bu bzlog tu me nga pa yin gshis/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal bstan rin po che'ang nyam rgyang du 'gro ba'i mgo brtsam pa dang / yul phyogs gang sar dus zing gis 'jig pa rtswa phung la me mched pa ltar byung bas hor zla lnga ba'i smad du chos skyabs gzim shag tu bos nas khyed cag 'khrul 'khor gong 'og dag chos mtshams kyi mjug tu sleb la nye ba yin kyang / da lta dmag 'khrugs kyis 'jigs nyen yod stabs de las g.yol ༵bas byas na dge mtshan che ba 'dug rma sa myur du rang cas dngo na slob

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa 'i mdzes rgyan/—rnams yul phyogs gzhan la chas dgos zhes zhal bkod lhu things ba stsal/'byung 'gyur sgribs med du gzigs pa'i gsung bzhin 'phral du rgya dmag thon te/ khong dpon slob kyi thog me mda'i mde'u ser drag ltar brgyab kyang khong gi thugs rjes su la'ang nyes skyon ma byung zhing /brag chen brgyud 'dzi'i nags rdzig ma'i khar zhag mal mdzad/ khong dang mnyam du bros byol du 'gro ba rnams thugs rje nus mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshul la dad gus 'gyur ba med pa thob tshul de yang bzhi brgya pa las/ rlabs chen yid can de la ni/ /'di na'ang gnod pa yod min te//des na de la srid pa dang //mya ngan 'das la khyad par med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar 'jigs pa mtha' dag las rnam par grol ba'i rlabs po che'i yid can yin pas 'jigs pa de lta bu'i glags mi rnyed pa'i gdengs thob pa yin no/ /de nas ma 'dzi'i khar zhag shas bzhugs shing tsho ba'i spyi srung du bskang gsol gyi dbu bzhugs mdzad/ ma 'gyang bar zhabs phyi 'gas chibs skyel dang bstun mdos tshang ru yod pa'i zur du gzim sbis phubs te thugs dam chags med mdzad/ de yang ji skad du/ rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ skal ldan zla 'od tsandan gyis bsil ba'i yangs pa'i ṭwāṃ

rnam pa ri thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa 'i mdzes rgyan/leb khang bzang nyams dga' bar/ /dgra med zhi ba'i nags klung g.yob pa yis/ /gzhan la phan don sems shing 'chag par byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar dben pa'i ri sul dge rtse'i gnas kyi sgrub phug tu rim gyis phebs te rjes 'jug skal ldan rnams kyi mig ltos phyir 'tsho ba dka' thub tsam la'ang mi re bar 'di snang chos brgyad kyi 'khri ba rbad kyis bcad nas gsang chen zab mo'i nyams len gyi gnad ma lus pa byang chub kyi sems rin po che'i khong du dril te nyams bzhes la drag tu brtson/ston khar 'jigs rab sku drung du bcar te/ pha dang rkar kho khri mon du chud pa la thugs brtag zhus par/ pha rang yul du bde 'byor mi nus/ nag po chen po'i bskangs gsol zhig byas na rkar kho bde blag ngang rang yul du sleb thub nges yin zhes lkog gyur gyi gnas mngon sum du gzigs pa'i 'gyur med rdo rje'i lung gis dbugs dbyungs/ dgun thog de gar bzhugs shing thugs dam 'phel ba'i ngos nas thun mtshams su nye gnas sangs rgyam dang / 'jigs dbang zung la dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po ngag dbang tshogs gnyis rgya mtshos mdzad 72

rnam pa ra thar ba sgru ba rgyud bstan pa 'e mdzes rgyan/pa'i blo sbyong don bdun ma'i 'grel ba byang chub lam gyi gsal byed steng nas tshig gi na yam tsam du ma song ba'i zhib khrid gnang ste shar bsgom byed du bcugaphyogs yar mar nas dad ldan ser skya mang po mjal du 'ong ba rnams la phyag dbang dang 'dod chos sogs kyis tshim par mdzad/dgung grangs nga brgyad pa sgyur byed ces pa sa phag lo'i dpyid thog tu shos rgab grong gi nye 'khor nags gseb cig tu shing gis phubs pa'i spyil bu la gnas byas te thugs dam zab mo'i nyams bzhes la gzhol/ thun gseng sogs stabs nam 'grig la mkhan skal bzang thar dang /sprul bsod nams stobs sogs don gnyer can 'ga' la blo sbyong don bdun ma'i bshad pa zheb rgyas sogs kyis dus 'da' bar mjad/ hor zla brgyad pa'i nang cam nas yul gru thams cad dmag ge dpung shed kyis rang gir bzung zhing snyigs mar spyod pa'i dus kyi rnam 'gyur gsal bar ston pa'i dbang gis sku dngos kyi gdul bya rdzogs pa'i bstan 'dzin phal mo che dgongs pa gzhan du gtad pa'i mtshams su slebs gshis rje nyid kyis kyang dag pa'i zhing khams su sgyu 'phrul gyi rtse dgas rol na dge mtshan che bar dgongs hā/

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i ma nges rgyan nye gnas zung la da lta kho bo 'dug kyang bstan 'gro la phan slebs che ba 'byung ba'i skabs med pas bsam bzhinatsho dag pa'i zhing du 'byon pa las tha mal ba'i tshul gyi bsnyun gzhi med tshul/ rang lo bcu gnyis son pa nas byang chub kyi sems rin po che zab gsang lam dang 'brel ba'i nyams len gyi gtso bor bzung ste bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis da lta kho bo'i lus ngag yid gsum 'phags mchog phyag na padmo'i sku gsung thugs rnam par dag pa'i snang ba kho na las tha mal gyi snang ba med pas khyed tshos bltas na ci 'dra 'dug lo gsum gyi sngon rol nas mnyam bzhag 'od gsal la 'byams pa'i skabs dag tu shar phyogs kyi zhing khams rnam par dag pa snod bcud thams cad dwangs gsal ind+ra ni la ltar kha dog sngon po shas che ba'i rnam pa lam lam snang 'dug pas mngon par dga' ba'i zhing du skye ba'i mtshan ma yin tshul/rdo grub rin po che la dam rdzas myong grol gyi sgo nas bye ma'i grangs kyi 'gro ba 'dren pa'i lung bstan byung ba ltar kho bo'i nye sngon phabs pa'i dam rdzas myong grol de la'ang rin po che'i dam rdzas mang du yod gshis sems can su zhig gis lce la myong ba tsam gyis ngan song gi skye sgo chod par the tshom med ces gsungs nas zhing brje bar thag bcad 74
