rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud ba3 na pa'i ma jes rgyan/de/shos rgab grong las skye bo'i 'du 'god cung dben pa'i sprul bsod nams stobs kyi gzim spyil du spar zhing /de nub dag zhing du dgongs pa gtad pa'i tshe glo bur du gzhon nu ma mdzes sdug lta ba'i chog mi shes pa zhig lhags pa'i ngag nas khyed kyi sku dngos kyi gdul bya ma rdzogs pas da dung bzhugs dang dus mthar bstan 'gro la phan pa rgya cher 'byung nges zhes lung bstan pa'i mur gnyug ma 'od gsal gyi dbyings las lhar ldang ngo / /phyi nyin nye gnas dag gis bla ma grong rsā bar thag bcad nas dal 'gros kyis gzim shag gi sgor slebs pa'i tshe khong gi nang nas bos te/ mdang nub dag zhing du dgongs pa gtad pa'i tshe bud med mdzes ma zhig gis da dung bzhugs dgos pa'i lung bstan gnang zhing de yang rje btsun sgrol ma yin pas gsung la rnam pa kun du bslu ba mi srid ces gsungs pas drung 'khesad pa dag dga' spro tshad las 'das pa byung / zla smad du rmis ki yangs dang /rtsis kyi ra sde'i nang shing gi spyil bu gsar du phubs te zla gsum du thugs dam chags med ngos sku sring dus chos su gyur ba'i rus pa me mchod dang rus sbyong mdzad/der sgron ma sku mdun du 'ongs bar gleng mol ma byas pa'i sngon rol nas rong chos kyis mar bskur ba de sgribs med ste

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa 'i mdzes rgyan/gzigs pa'i dri rmed sogs kyis khoranga'ajigasazhumapabyung wa wadagung grangs nga dgu pa kun lngan zhes pa lcags byi'i lo'i hor zla dang po'i nang gsang stabs kyis snyigs chung phug pa ra re zheng/ bzhugs/gsum nga 'i yar ches la sngar sku sring gis khyim so 'dzin pa 'i thos chang zhes pa'i gzhes skar gsang stabs kyis phebs te/ thugs dam zab mo'i nyam/sa bzhes la gcig tu gzhol bas khang pa'i bar khya3/sa su sngad med nga 'i me tog dasmu/ra ser 'dab ma shin du mang ba zhig gsar du skyes pa'i dge mtshan byung / thun mtshams su sku sring gi rus phye sā tstsha btab pa sogs thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i bas gas sbyangs la brtson/ bar skabs shig thos gis po khri mon du tshe dus byas pa'i tshu smu lkog gyur mngon sum du gzigs pa 'i bas/'a mchid stsal / der bzhugs ring rgyal sras bdag nyid chen po rnams kyi mchod pa phul ba bzhin bya snyam nga 'i 'phen pa btang ste mtshan thub pa'i rkong bu zhun mar gyis bltams pa'i sgron me 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam dang 2brel nas bstan 'gro'i bde thabs 'ba' zheg snye pa dgongs pa'i thugs bskyed rlabs po che'i sgo nas mtsham sa sbyar bas nyin zhag spyar bzhi thub pa sogs ngo ma/tshar ba'i ltas bzang gu ma dus su byung /

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/yar phebs khar bag leb sogs byas te gsol ston mtshon tsam gyi thog nye 'khor rnams la thugs mnyes pa'i gsung gleng mang du gnang ba'i mjug tu dge sdig spang blang las 'phros pa'i bslab 'doms gnad du dril ba stsal/skabs 'di tsam na dus kyi 'pho 'gyur chen po byung ba'i dbang gis chos bzhin spyod pa'i skye bo phal mo che nyams nyes shing ming gi lhag mar gyur pa'i dus su gtugs na'ang dam pa khong ni rgyal po'i chad pa'i las kyi 'jigs pas khri mon du gnas 'cha' dgos pa lta ci/ tha na tshogs 'du tsam la'ang phebs dgos ma byung zhing / snyigs dus kyi skye bo'i bya spyod gang gis kyang g.yo ba med par dus tshes dge ba'i nyin rang yul du phebs/ bags skusna tshang gi khang chung zhig la gnas mal byas te rgyun gyi rnal 'byor chags med mdzad/ nyin gcig mtshan ldan sku drung du bcar te / khyed 'chi ba la rang dbang thob pa'i rnal 'byor ba yin pas sngar nas gzugs sku'i spros pa dor na legs lam che ba las dus ngan snyigs ma'i mar gsham 'dir steng gi bkod khyab kyis nged cag khyed la sgro bskur sogs ya nga ba'i las bsags par byed du bcug pa'am khri mon du gnas 'cha' dgos pa gang rung 'byung 77

rnam pa ra thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa ri sa res rgyan nges yin zhes sdug yus kyi tshor ba snying la mda' bsnun pa dang mtshungs pas mchi ma'i char rgyun gyis bzhin ras rlan par gyur ba'i tshe/khong gi zhal 'dzum bag dang bcas te snga sor rgyal yum sgrol ma'i lung bstan du kho bo re zhig bzhugs na khri mon du 'gro mi dgos pad bstan 'gro'i don du 'gyur bar gsungs bas bdag nyid chen po dag gi mdzad pa ni gdul bya'i skal ba kho na la ltos tshul dang / khyed cag gi snod dang bca' lag rnams nyar tshags gyis dang rjes su 'bru rigs snod kyis ma chud par gos sogs kyi nang du byug dgos byung ba'ang 'byung srid ces gsungs te/ yid gsos kyi bslab bya sgo du ma nas phebs/ tshul de ni mdo rgyan las/ sems can kun gyi bya ba la/ / 3khyod ni dus las mi 'da' bas/ /mdzad pa rtag tu don mnga' ba mi bsnyel khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /lo mjug tu 'go byed mi sna 'gas khong gi dgongs pa dang bstun 'be tsa'i khang steng du spar te thugs bag phab pa'i ngang rgyun gyi nyams bzhes la gzhol/ skabs shig 'go bla sku mched yang sku tshe'i 'du byed rdzogs par 'bri zhig yod pa de 'go byed dag gis khong la 'bul dīr thugs dam spyan dmigs rgya cher mdzad/ nyin gcig phun tshogs

rnam pa ra thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/sku mdun du 'khod pa'i tshe/khong gi zhal nas/'go bla bde ba can du skye bar shin tu rigs mod/ 'on kyang kho bo'i nyams dang 'od gsal 'dres pa'i snang ba la bla ma blo grags de dge sbyong rnam par dag pa'i cha spyad kyis 'ongs te/ khyed kyi thugs bskyed smon lam zab mo'i mthu las nged cag sku mched dga' ldan yide dga' chos 'dzin du rgyal ba mi pham pa'i zhabs drung du skyes nas dam pa'i chos kyi dga' ston la rol bzhin mchis zhes nged rang la bsnyen bkur gyi tshul du me tog gtor bzhin/ khyod ni ma dang khyod ni pha ste khyod ni 'gro ba'i bla ma khyod ni gnyen dang grogs bzang yang / /zhes sogs nas/ khyod ni dman pa rnams kyi mgon dang yid bzhin nor bu rgyal ba'i dbang po khyod la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes pa'i tshig gis dus dus su bsngags brjod kyi rol mo 'brol du byung ba'i bka' mchid stsal/ de yang gter chen padma tshe dbang mchog gis rje btsun byams pa'i zlos gar du bsngags pa de don la gnas pa'i rtags su 'khums so/ /༈ dgung grangs drug cu pa 'phar ba zhes pa lcags glang 31ra rgyal bstan sprin bar gyi nyi zhur tsam byung ba nas bstan pa kho na thugs la bcings te snyigs ma'i 'gro la rgyal ba gzhan las thugs bskyed dang 79

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan smon lam gyi mthu rlabs po che mngon du gyur ba'i sman gyi bla bde bar gshegs pa mched brgyad kyi cho ga paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis mdzad pa de thugs dam gyi mthil du bzung ste phyag mchod dang bzlas brjod 'chag med mdzad pas sman bla'i sgrub gtor 'od phung gi rnam par gyur zhing skabs skabs su bdud rtsi babs pa dang / rnam lnga'i zhal zas las me tog dkar ser dmar ljang mang du 'khrungs pa soṭa dge mtshan khyad par ba du ma byung zhing / de dang dus mtshungs yul khams thams cad du mu ge'i bskal ba ya nga ba sogs dus kyi rgud pa mtha' dag khad kyis zhi ba byung ngo/ /de skabs mkhan skal bzang thar khri mon gyi bcad rgya las grol bas khong gis sku mdun du 'ong dgos pa'i bskul ma gnang ba ltar mjal kha zhus par/ khyed rang khrims ra nas glod grol byung ba la spro ba che tshul dang / da lta bstan pa la nyams 'grib chen po thebs pa'i rkyen gyis nyid la yig cha sogs rten gang yang lhag med stabs 'di nas kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams kyi gser sku dang sman mdo brgyad brgya ba dag pa'i zhing mchog ma'i yi ge/ dam rdzas myong grol rnams khyed la rten skal du bstsal ba yin pa'i rgyu mtshan/ nged kyis bstan 80

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bsnyan pa'i mdzesargyan/'gro'i rgud pa sel thabs kho na la dmigs nas dag pa'i zhing mchog ma blo la mang du bskyar ba ltar khyed kyis kyang de bzhin mdzad na bstan 'gro la phan slebs che ba re 'byung srid cing / kho bo'i bzlas brjod sogs rnam par dkar ba'i las gang byas thams cad phyi ma las tshe 'di'i bde thabs su dmigs ma myong ba dang / de las kyang gzhan don 'ba' zhig dmigs pa las rang don dmigs pa med pa'i tshul thuṭa mnyes pa'i gsung gleng gnang tshe mkhan po tshang ha las pa byung ste yi ge drug ma'i rig sngags dung re ngag thog nas bzla bar khas len byas/phyis su zhal gdams de nam dran tshe dad pa dbang med du skye ba'i grogs bdag rkyen lta bu byung zhes nyis stong bzhi'i lor khong gis phun tshogs la gleng mol byas pa'i skabs su byung ba ltar bris pa yin zhing /de yang rgyal tshab mi pham pas/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar gzhan don du bla med byang chub bsgrub pa yin pas ched du bya ba grub nas kyang mdzad pa thams cad ni gzhan don las ma 'das pa dang / mdo rgyan las kyang / de ltar bdag bas gzhan don mchog 'du shes/ /rang gi don gang gzhan gyi don gang yin/ /zhes byang chub sems dpa'i 81

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa 'i mdzes rgyan/gnas skabs su gzhan don kho na las rang don sgrub pa med pa'i tshul gsungs pa ltar mdzad pa yin no/ /dgung grangs re gcig pa chu stag la'ang sngar bzhin dus kyi rgud pa sel thabs kho nar dmigs te sman chog la brtson pa cher bskyed mdzad pas yul 'dir rgyu 'grul byed pa'i skye bo mi srun pa dag gis kyang zhal mjal ba tsam gyis blo sna 'gyur zhing gnod pa'i sbyor ba dor zhing / yul gyi 'go byed mi sna dang ser skya yongs nas gsol zas dang chu shing sogs 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen gang 'os dus thog tu sbyar ro/ /dgung grangs re gnyis pa chu yo'i lo'i dbyar thog tu skyabs mgon mtshan bzang rin po che zab chos sgo skyel du phebs kyang dus dbang gis ma 'dzom par gsol ston gyi thog thugs nang gshin pa'i gsung gleng mang du 'phel ba byung zhing /chas khar phebs rdzong bstar te 'bral mi phod ngang chibs skyel zhus/dgung grangs re gsum pa shing 'brug lor khong la dad 'dun che ba'i stan lo dang mgon tshang chos ldan gnyis tsha rting du mjal kha zhus par dus kyi 'pho 'gyur las brtsam pa'i gsung mchid mang gnang du ba'i mthar gsol ba'i rigs du ma sku mdun du phul bar sku la 'phrod 82

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzesargyan/'jug kyi rigs 'ga' re tsam las phon che ba phyir slog ste 'phral phug gnyis gar sman pa'i bslab 'dams gnang /dgung grangs re bzhi pa shing sprul la sku mtshams dam por yun ring bzhugs shing /thun mtshams shig tu stan lo sku drung du bcar chog pa'i dgongs khrol byung ba ltar phyin par dngos 'bul la stan dkar legs pa zhig yod pa de spyan lam du bstar ma nus par nye 'khor du sbas pa'ang thugs kyis mkhyen/ lo snga phyi 'di dag tu bza' btung soṭa longs spyod kyi dbul ba'i rkyen gyis sku 'phrog bcom gsum 'ba' zhig byed pa'i skye bo dag la de rigs ldog dgos pa'i ljags bkod gnang ba tsam gyis zhi 'jags su btang bas/ yul phyogs gang sar a skyong tsho ba zhes skye bo kun gyis mig ltos byed yul du gyur/dgung grangs re lnga pa me rta lor skye rgu'i bsod nams kyi skal ba dman pa'i dbang gis gtsug lag khang sogs rten 'gang chen dag gi phrin las kyi mthug bsdus pa'i skabs su slebs yang dam pa khong la nyams nyes gang yang ma byung bar sgrub pa la gzhol zhing / bar skabs shig sku bsnyun bzhes pa'i tshul gyis thugs dgongs 'od gsal gyi dbyings su thim la nye ba'i tshe dge sbyong gi cha spyad 'dzin pa 83

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzesargyan/zhig thol gyis byung ste ḍa ma ru drag tu 'khrol ba'i sgas bslangs pa dang / de bzhin dung chen gling bu sogs dang / rgobs rer bud med mang pos cho nge btab pa'i sgras thugs dgongs 'od gsal gyi dbyings nas bslangs ba sogs kyis sku snyun dwangs skyed la'ang phan slebs che ba byung / de dag ni phun tshogs sogs zhal slob 'ga' la gsung 'phros kyi lhungs su byung ba ltar ro/ /dgung grangs re drug pa me lug la gzhis ka de nyid du thugs dam chags med ngos sman chog la brtson bzhin sku mtshams dam por bzhugs/ dgun thog mchog sprul 'gro phan rgya mtshos dkar yol rtags leb shin du legs pa zhig grwa btsun ngag po zer ba brgyud nan tan chen pos skur ba de mtshams khongs su sku mdun la phul bar khong gi zhal 'dzum tsam mdzad nas skar shub rtsis mthong che ba zhig yin ang gsungs te/ phyir slog grab mdzad tshe kho 'jig chum pa byung ste khyed la phul ba yin zhes zhus/ phyis su sprul sku 'gro phan la bla ma de mngon mkhyen thogs med mnga' bas kho rang shin du dad pa'i rgyu mtshan nang sbyar lugs su mol bar grags/dgung grangs re bdun pa sa sprel lo'i hor zla lnga ba'i nya dang 84

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/bstun lo snga ma dag tu dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis yul khams spyi dang bye brag kun la sngar ma grags pa'i mi nad sna tshogs rdol zhing rims nad kun nas mched pa'i gnyen por dgongs te/ dam rdzas myong grol chen mo dang / rin chen ril bu/ nad gsar ril bu te gsar du phab pa'i ril bu rnams sman chog la brten nas 'chi med bdud rtsi lta bur byin phabs te nad kyis nyen pa'i 'gro ba nyam thag pa grangs las 'das pa zhig dam rdzas myong grol gyi sgo nas phan pa rgya cher sgrub pa yin la/ de'ang sman pa phal mo ches ngos 'jin tsam yang 'byung dka' ba'i bro nad drag pos zin pa rnams kyi kha la reg pa tsam gyis 'phral du nad kyi zug ngu zhi ba yin te/ rgad po pag bra zhes pa de zas bkag nad kyis nyen te bza' btung gi rigs nyin zhag mang por khog tu ma song ba'i tshe dam rdzas de myong ba tsam gyis 'phral du dwangs skyed byung ba dang / stong gsal gyi yon bdag ngang ba rgad po yang de bzhin nad kyis gdung ba la dam rdzas bsten pa'i mur phan slebs che ba byung ba dang / zi lang du slob grar yod pa'i slob ma zhig glo bur du dus nad drag pos zin te sman gyi gso thabs ma byung ba la slob grogs shig gi rke na yod pa'i dam rdzas myong grol de lce la myong ba tsam 85

rnam par thar ba sgru ba rgyud bstan pa 'i mdzes rgyan gyis gzhi med du dwangs pa lta bu mjad pa'i cha shas phra mo re'ang gzhan la phan pa 'byung ba'i rgyu kho nar 'gro zhing /dam pa gang nyid zhing brje'i pa'i sa rta'i lor ka dag la bla ma gsal bzang nas sems tshol byas te dam pa gong ma'i phyag srol ltar nyin bdun gyi mtshams nas lan chul bzhin dgos pa'i dus la gtugs pa na/ nyin mchan khor yug tu dpyad kyang blo gdeng khel po ma byung bar tha ma'i nyin ji nyid la gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab ste mnal du song ba'i tshe rje nyid dngos su byon nas sems kyi gnas lugs ji lta ba bzhin ngo sprad pa lta bu mdor na phrin las kyi 'jug pa rgya mtsho'i rlabs ltar dus las yol ba med pa'i chul ni/ rgyal ba ma pham pas/ gang dang gang la gang dang ni/ /gang tshe bya ba phan gyur pa/ /de dang de la der snang ngo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /dgung grangs re brgyad pa sa bya'i lo'i sos kur gral rim gtsang gshar gyi 'gul spyod drag po'i gdong la babs tshe mi tshang re re bzhin gral rim mtho dman la zhib 'jug byas pas skye bo blun zhing gti mug pa zhig gi ngag nas mdos dbon zhes pa'i bla chen zhig yod sdu'i drogs gzhi bslang stabs las byed 'gas kya gyu'i sbyor ba la

rnam par thar pa sgrub rgyud bste ma pa'i mdzes rgyan/brten nas ched gnyer gyis khyim slog pa'i sta gon byed pa sogs 'byung 'gyur thams cad sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes kyi spyan gyis gziṭa na'ang gzhan gyis brda btang ba'i zol gyis chos dang mthun pa'i bca' lag dag mi mngon par sbas shing / de 'phral las byed mi srun pa 'gas khyim phyi nang med pa mtha' dag zhib tu slog kyang don du gnyer ba'i dngos po cung zad tsam yang ma rnyed par de dag shugs ring nar gyis phyung ste phyir ldog go /phyi nyin tshogs 'du dza drag 'tshogs pa'i thog yul 'di'i ser skya drag zhan thams cad kyis mdos dbon zer ba de sngar nas 'chi zin pas 'di ni mdos tshang gi thang bu chung ngu nas yul 'khyar du song ba'i spyon pa 'chi la khad pa de yin zhes mgrin gcig tu brjod pas de dag gis glags lta ba'i skabs ma byung bar mkho sprod byas so/ /hor zla bzhi pa'i nang phun tshogs nu bo gnam lcags lhung ba'i rkyen gyis dus las 'das pa'i bsngo rten du mar dang bzhes snod phul te/thugs dam spyan dmigs dgos tshul gyi zhu nan che zhing nyin gsum gyi rjes pur dur khrod du bskyal khar skra rtags ma byung bar slar yang pad tshul brgyud 'pho ba gzab nan zhig bka' drin skyongs dgos pa'i 87

rnam par thar pa sgrub rgyud bsta na pa'i rma dzesargyan/zhu ba nan can phul ba la gsung lan zhal bzhes yid chims pa stsal ste/ 'pho lung sogs thugs dam spyan dmigs gnad smin gnang bas pur dur khrod du slebs mtshams skra rtags lhungs 'dug cing / nyin shas kyi rjes phun tshogs drung du bcar ba'i tshe 'pho ba'i rtags byung na ci 'dra yin zhus par de ni lha mi'i lus rten khyad par ba re blang thub pa'i mtshan mar nges so zhes 'gyur ba med pa'i rdo rje'i gsungs gis dbugs dbyung zhing / dpal ldan zla ba grags pas kyang / dag pa 'di ni bzhed pa 'jug pa yis/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar bzhed pa 'jug pa'i nyams rtogs kyi rtsal rdzogs te yon tan gyi gter chen por gyur ba'i stobs kyis gshin po de nyid btsan thabs kyis mngon mtho'i rten la sbyar ba yin par mngon no/ /dgung grangs re dgu pa lcags khyi'i gnam lo gsar tshes nas ji skad du/ zla ba sgron me'i mdo las/ rtag tu zhi zhing dga' ba dben par rgyu/ /lus dang ngag dang yid kyang rab bsdams 'gyur/ /dgon par gnas pa 'di la yon tan mang / /de ni thar ba'i rjes su mthun pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dben pa'i yon tan gyi ro myong ba'i phyir thugs dam nyams bzhes mchog gi bcad rgya la yun ring 88

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud brnya na pa 'i mdzesargyan/bzhugs/ ston thog khong gnas pa'i ka thog skor chung gis 'bru rigs kyi phud rgya ma sum brgya dang mar spus legs rgya ma sum cu lhag rje nyid kyi gsol chas su phul rgyu'i skal ba mngon du gyur zhing khyad par bzang ras kyis g.yogs pa'i tshar thul spus gtsang shig na bza'i dod du phul ba la/ bzo byed mi snas mtshon yul 'di'i skye rgu rnams kyi rnam par dkar ba'i bsod nams kyi phung po ci snyed cig bsags pa'i phyir re zhig bzhes pa'i tshul gyis bka' lan ci yang ma gnang /nyin gcig phun tshogs zhabs drung du 'khod pa'i tshe/kho bo'i mi tshe hril bor tshar thul zhig banab pa med pas da ni 'chi kha ma'i dus su na bza' nyer spyad sogs kyi dgos mkho med tshul gsungs te nan gyis phyir slog tshul de ni 'khri shing las/ longs spyod skad cig kho nas 'bral bas na/ /'byor ba'i rmi lam bag ma len dang mtshungs/ /bde ba'i dpal ni rlung bsnun mar me'i rtse/ /srid pa'i spyod tshul 'di dag spyon pa'i gar/ / zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs bcud thugs nyams su bstar ba yin no/ /dgung grangs bdun bcu pa lcags phag lo'i hor zla bdun pa'i nyi shu gsum la slar yang khri dar lung ma khyad 'phags shig gis 89

rnam pas thar ba sgrub rgyud bsta na pa 'i rme jes rgyan/mtshon sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel du ma dang / dga' ldan bdud rtsi ma sogs rten 'dus 'gang chen rnams gang la'ang mi gnod pa'i 'phrod 'jug gi sman phye dang sbyar te/ dam rdzas myong grol chen mo dang nad gsar ril bu sogs phab ste sman chog gi sgo nas bsgrub pas skabs skabs su de dag las bdud rtsi bab pa'i dge mtshan byung /dgung grangs don gcig pa chu byi'i lor slar yang sku mtshams dam po'i sgo nas thugs dam nyams bzhes chu bo'i rgyun bzhin mdzad pa'i chul ni/skyes rabs las/rtsol ba med par bas mtha' na//zhi ba rab tu gzhol zhing 'khod/ /dge ba rnams ni yon tan la/ /re ba snying la 'jog par byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /dpyid thog stong gsal gyis zhu sna byas te mtshams khongs su phran bus mjal kha zhus par thugs mnyes pa'i gsung mchid mang du gnang ba'i mjug tu rta mgrin mngon rtogs kyi ljags khrid dang / lung kha shas kyis bka' drin bskyangs/ dus der yul phyogs 'di'ang bdag nyid chen po 'di bzhugs pa'i bka' drin gyis yul la g.yang chags/sa la byin bab snod bcud thams cad bag dro bas yul 'di'i skye bo mchog dman mtha' dag bza' btung sogs longs spyad kyis 90

rnam ske ra thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/snum chil ler gnas shing / phyogs gzhan gyi mi zhig gis bltas na'ang yul 'dir bde skyid dbyar mtsho rgyas pa lta bu'i rang skyid gzhan smon gyi dpal la yid dbang 'phrog pa zhig yod pa ni sku tshe du mar bsags pa'i tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i bdag 'bras su byung ba yin te/phrugs kyi tshom las/ dgon pa'am yang na grong dag gam/ /gshong ngam thang bu dag kyang rung / /gang na 'phags pa bzhugs pa yi/ /sa de yid du 'ong ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /smras pa/rdul bral gzigs pa dag pa'i ye shes ngor/ /brtan g.yo gang la'ang thogs rdug mi mnga' bas/ /'byung 'gyur bde sdug chu yi gnyer ma la/ /mngon sum 'doms pa'i lung gis go skabs phyes/ /snyigs ma'i rang mchang rdol ba'i dus zing gis/ /yang yang nyen pa'i ltos bcas skye bo kun/ /mi shigs srung ba'i 'khor lor rab bcings nas/ /nyer 'che'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i dbugs dbyung stsal/ /zab gsang lam la mdza' ba ma btang bas/ /91

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mjes rgyan skye bo'i 'du 'god nyer zhi'i nags klung du/ /sgrub la gcig tu gzhol ba'i rtse dga' yang / /dus kyi mthar yang rol ba nyams ma gyur/ /thugs dgongs 'od gsal dbyings su phyogs pa'i tshe/ /'phral du arha ta re'i zhal bzang nyid/ /mngon sum gzigs pa'i mod la bde dga' dang / /bstan 'gror phan pa'i lung bstan dus su thob/ /cher snyigs rgud pa bdo ba'i 'thor rlung las/ /bskal gsum duḥkha 'bar ba'i klong nyid du/ /mtha' dbus skye bo nyam thag gyur ba'i tshe/ /de yis g.yo bar ma nus rdo rje'i lhun/ /bstan dang 'gro la gcig tu sman pa'i slad/ /snyigs ma'i mgon po bde gshegs mched brgyad kyi/ /mdo mchog snying por dgongs pa'i mthil bsnams pas/ /dus kyi rgyad tshogs mi mngon dbyings su yib/ /ces dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rje bya btang ba sangs 92

rgyas rdo rje dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar ba mdo tsam brjod pa sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan ja'i chu bo'i gser gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba las dus ngan snyigs ma'i mar gsham du'ang thabs tshul sna tshogs kyi sgo nas 'gro don bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad pa'i skabs te lnga ba'o//

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa 'i mdzes rgyan/drug pa/ mdzad pa'i tha ma bstan pa dang dgongs rdzogs sogs ji ltar bsgrubs pa'i skabs// dgung grangs don gnyis pa chu glang la sngar bzhin thugs dam nyams bzhes kyi rim pa rnams yar ldan gyi ngos sman chog kyang chags med mdzad pas 'di yan sman bla'i mtshan sa ya bcu gcig long zhes grags/ thun mtshams su mjal kha 'gog pa sogs gu dog gi rigs gtan nas mi mdzad par bka' slob dag la mdzad pa tha ma'i gsung zur sogs phyis 'byung la dgongs pa'i bka' mchid gnang mod su la'ang rtog dpyod ma zhugs so/ /de yang gtsug na nor bu'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dabalas/ dpal 'di yud tsam gar mkhan dang / /dus kyi sprin glog 'byugs pa dang / /'khor ba'i sprul gyi ro 'dzin ni/ /rnam par rtse bzhin rab tu g.yo/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar rje nyid kyi drika' drin la brten nas yul khams 'dir bde skyid kyi dpal phun dze

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/sum tshogs pa 'byung ba de ring du mi gnas par g.yo zhing mi rtag pa'i ngang tshul la dgongs par mngon no/ / sa zla'i tshes bcu gcig nyin nas phun tshogs dang phran bu la blo sbyong don bdun ma'i 'grel ba byang chub lam gyi gsal byed kyi dmigs khrid nyams su len tshul dam pa gong ma'i man ngag gis brgyan te/ nyams myong gi steng nas zhib rgyas su gnang ba'i mgo brtsam ste nyin mang bor bka' drin bskyangs/ stobs lnga'i mtshams su slebs skabs khong gis 'chi dus stobs lnga go bzlog dgos pas rnam snang chos bdun dang / seṅge nyal stabs gang rung gi stangs ga byas na dge mtshan che tshul dang / bla ma rin po che'ang hor zla drug pa'i nang zhing brje dus seṅge nyal stabs kyis g.yon mnyam bzhag mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan las 'phros pa'i bslab 'doms gnad 'dril yid kyi gsos sman du stsal/ blo sbyong gi mjug grub pa na phran bu cag la byang sdom gnang rgyu'i zhal bzhes mdzad yod kyang hor zla lnga ba'i tshes 'go nas sku cung zad ltem pa'i chul bstan pas byang sdom gnang ba'i tshe slob dpon sku bzhengs te phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams la me tog gtor dgos pa'i bya ba sogs ni rkang ba'i mi nus pas rjes sor 95

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mardzesargyan/stabs nam 'grig la slar yang gsung chog ces phebs sgo gnang / de skabs grong grong sogs phyogs yar mar gyi sman pa nyams rgyu'i can 'ga' zhig bos te thams cad kyi phyag rtsa dang chab rtags sogs zhib tu byas nas khong dang dgongs bsdur gyis bsnyung gzhi glo ba chu bsags yin par thag bcad de gsol sman kha shas bsten kyang phan slebs cher ma byung / khams sangs la dgongs te khang ba'i bar khyams su yol bas bcad pa'i gsar phub kyi spyil bo la rgyun bzhugs mdzad/ slob 'bangs rnams kyi zhabs brtan du sgor 'byor tshad dang bstun skor chung gsum pa'i sbra nag zhig 'dzi ska nas nyo tshong gi rdzu la brten yi ge blangs te lam du chas khar phun tshogs dang phyir zhes gnyis kyis de dag gi rgyu mtshan rnams snyan du gsol bas thugs mnyes pa'i bka' lan bzang po gnang ste/ bla ma blos phrin dang blos grags rnam gnyis la stan dkar dri ma med pa re res mtshon 'bul ba gang 'tsham bskur te skyabs 'jug dang phyogs de ga'i dam rdzas myong grol sogs rten 'dus 'gangs chen dag lag son dgos pa'i zhal bkod bstsal/ de gnyis 'dzi ska la 'byor mtshams bla ma rnam gnyis snros ljags bkod dang bstun rta mgrin/ phyag rdor/ tshe bsnyen rnams

rnam pa ra thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/la dung yon re re dang / mdo gdugs sgrol gsum gsol kha bcas la khri tshar re re sogs zhabs brtan phon che ba bsgrubs/ zla de'i legs pa brgyad 'dzom nyin gza' skar gyi sbyor ba'ang phun sum tshogs pas de gnyis gzim shag tu 'byor nas bla ma rnam gnyis kyis bskur ba'i 'tshams skyes dang dam rdzas myong grol bcas sku mdun du phul bas dam rdzas myong grol la rje nyid kyang thugs dgyes nyams tshad med mdzad/ sngar nas zhal bzhes yod pa'i 'dzam ngos rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i zab mo gcod kyi lus sbyin sogs lung kha shas kyang bla ma e mgon dang pad tshul sogs don gnyer can 'ga' la dus thog tu gnang /hor zla drug pa'i tshes brgyad nas sngar gyi dam rdzas myong grol chen mo'i phabs rgyun gyi steng du gsar du byung ba'i rin chen ril bu dgurin chen mang sbyor brgya dang bcu gsum/ sangs rgyas ring bsrel lnga/khri dar lung khyad 'phags/ 'dzam thang nas bskur ba'i rten 'dus rnams gang la'ang mi gnod pa'i sman phye dang sbyar te dam rdzas myong grol dang / nad gsar ril bu rnams gsar du phabs shing gtan pa med par gang la gang 'tsham gyi gtong ba'i sgo 'phar yang yang phyes 97

rnam pas thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan ri 'i rma dzes rgyan/pas nad gdon drag pos nyam thag tu gyur ba sogs snyigs ma'i 'gro ba yongs kyi mgon dang / skyabs dang / dpung gnyen gcig pur gyur to/ /de'ang dam rdzas myong grol gyi sgo nas sems can grangs las 'das pa zhig ngan song gi skye sgo bkag nas mngon mtho dang nges legs la sbyar ba'i tshul yang /chos dbang gter byon rig pa mchog gi rgyud las/ril bu su yi stor song naḥ tshe rabs gang dang gar skyes kyang ཿ spyan ras gzigs dang 'bral mi sridaḥ ces dang / byang gter 'gro don las sbyor lnga ba las/ rdzas de ltor song sdig sgribs dgaḥ bar do'i duḥkha 'phags pas skyobasaḥ zhes dang / thugs rje chen po gsang ba bla na med pa'i rang gzhung las/ shig gi snying tsam su yi ltor song naḥ zhes sogs nas/ mon bu kla klo log lta shan pa bcasaḥ gang gis myong tshad thar ba'i sa la regaḥ zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pa bzhin no/ /tshes bcu dgu'i snga dro chab rtags kyi phyir phun tshogs drung du bcar bar/ rje nyid seṅge nyal stabs kyis gzim pa ltar mdzad pa'i dus su khel bas khong gi zhal nas/mdang nub dag zhing la dgongs pa gtad na 'phral du 'chi nus kyang da lta dus la ma bab pa'i dbang gis phrag 98

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/pa nas drod zhig mched pa'i rkyen gyis 'od gsal gyi dbyings nas bslang tshul sogs gsungs pa ni/ nam 'dod 'dod du sku tshe 'pho thub pa'i skye 'chi la dbang thob pa'i rtags 'khrul med kyi gsungs su 'khums shing / de skabs phun tshogs nas da dung bstan 'gro 'ba' zhig la dgongs te yun ring bzhugs pa'i thugs 'dun gnang dgos zhes mchi ma'i thigs phreng dang bcas gsol ba btab par thugs brtse ba'i stangs ka mdzad/ de nas cher ma 'gyang bar bla ma dam pa bshad sgrub dpal ched gnyer gyis mjal 'dzom byas te bzhugs zhus phul ba dang / de mtshungs gter chen padma tshe dbang mchog gis kyang tshe dpag med kyi sku bsnyan dang zhu shog bcas zhal slob nang ma brgyud phyag tu phul bar rje nyid kyang thugs dgyes nyams mjad pas drung 'khod pa rnams sems bde 'bol gyis song / rje nyid sku snyan cung zad bzhes pa'i nyams byung ba nas bzung khams mi bde ba gtan med par nam rgyun nyams shin du bde ba'i rnam pa bstan te zhal 'dzum bag dang bcas spyan zung bar snang hrig ger gzigs bzhin gnas lugs zab mo'i ngang du 'byams klas pa yin la/ nyin gcig rje nyid kyis kho bo'i mi tshe 'di la gcig na srung sdom gyi phyogs dang /99

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/gnyis na dge sbyor/ gsum na bskyed rdzogs nyams len sogs gang thad nas 'di ma byas snyam pa cung zad tsam med chul gsungs pa ni gsung gi tha ma ste/ rjes 'jug bu slob rnams la zhal chems bdud rtsi'i zegs ma snying gi bcud du stsal ba yin par gor ma chag go /de ltar sku'i rnam pa de nyid kyis 'dul ba'i gdul bya dang mdzad pa'i mtha' rdzogs pa na/ ji skad du/ theg pa chen po mdo sde rgyan las/ji ltar chu yi snod chag na/ /zla ba'i gzugs snyan mi snang ba/ /de bzhin sems can ngan pa la/ /sangs rgyas gzugs kyang mi mthong ngo / /zhes gsungs pa ltar long yod phyi bgol gyi ngang du me tshe hril bor bskyal zhing / srid pa'i phun tshogs la shi spar 'tham pa'i bdag dang bdag 'dra'i rtag 'jin can rnams chos la bskul phyir/dgung grangs don gnyis bzhes pa chu mo glang gi lo'i chu stod zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi rdzogs pa gnyis pa'i sa sros kyi dus su ston pa thugs rje can gye rnam thar bzhin seṅge nyal stabs kyis bzhugs te/spyan zung bar snang la hrig ger gzigs bzhin shangs bug gi rgyu ba phyir bsal nas nang du 'jug pa na thugs dgongs chos dbyings su 'od gsal ma bu dbyer med kyi ngang snyoms par zhugs nas nyin zhag 100

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/'ga' zhig gi bar thugs dam g.yo ba med pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe dpal ldan bla ma mchog gis mngon du mdzad pa'i 'od gsal chos skur mtshon pa lta bu'i phyi rtags su nam mkha' bee lhur zhun ma'i mdog ltar shin tu dwangs shing gsal bar gyur nas rlung bser bu tsam yang ldang ba med pa dang / nang rtags su sku gdung gi drod ma yal bar gnyer ma dang kham khum med cing zhal gyi dkyil 'khor ston zla rgyas pa ltar gyur to/ /de nas sku rjes su rgyun bcar ba rnams dam pa'i mgon dang bral ba'i mya ngan gyis dran pa stor ba ltar ci bya gtol med du gyur kyang bzod bsran bskyed de phyag mchod gsol 'debs sogs la 'bad cing / nyin zhag du mar bzhugs yod pa ltar byas te gsang rgya dam por byas/ zhag gnyis kyi mtshams nas thugs dam grol ba'i tshe/dbang mdor bstan las/sangs rgyas kun gyi mdzod spu yi/ /padmar zla ba bdud rtsi nya/ /nyi rdul gnam stong gsang ba ste/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dkar cha steng gi shangs bug nas lud pa phyag mthil du 'o ma 'khyil ba ltar gnas pa dang / dmar cha rdo rje nor bu'i rtse nas byung 01

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/ba'ang ches gsal bar mngon pa ni/ bla ma e mgon/ bla ma rar rgyam/chul rgyam/ phun tshogs/ phran bu rnams la mthun snang du grub pas dpal ldan jo nang ba'i rnal 'byor ba rab kyi khyad chos bla na med pa yin no/ /de yang rje btsun mi la ras pa mchog gis/ nga ni shar phyogs zhing khams su/ /mkha' 'gro mang po 'dus pa'i nang / /mngon par dga' ba'i zhing de na/ /bcom ldan bde mchog 'khor lo dang / /sbyan ras gzigs mgon sgrol ma'i tshogs//kun bzang bde ba'i gnas de sa/mkha' 'gro mang po'i bsu ma yod/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gzugs sku rags pa'i za ma tog skal ba ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams kyi bsod nams kyi zhing du bzhag ste/ don dam bden pa 'od gsal gyi ngang 'ja' tshon gyi lus tsam la brten nas nam mkha' gang ba'i dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i mchod rdzas kyi bye brag du ma thogs pa rnams kyis mdun bsus te/ shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing du rgyal ba mi 'brugs pa'i spyan sngar theg pa mchog gi chos kyi dga' ston la gshegs par gyur to/ /nyi shu brgyad kyi snga dro zhabs gras rnams kyis sku gdung la dri 102

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzesargyan/bzang sbyar ba'i chus gdung khrus dang gnas yig gdagasashing bzang gos ser bo'i gdung dkris/chos gos dang rig lnga sogs longs sku'i chas 'jug phul te/ khri bshams pa'i khar gdan drangs/ phyi dro nas bzung dad ldan ser skya yongs nas res mos kyis gdung mjal zhus par gdung khrus dang dam rdzas myong grol na bza' rnams kyi tshim par byas/ gdung mjal thog mar zhus pa nas brtsams rim gyis 'byor ba rnams kyis sku gdung rin po che'i mdun nas khas len byas pa'i grangs 'bor bsdoms pas ma ṇi dung phyur yig brgya bye ba sogs dang / dge sgrub sdig spang byed pa mang du byung / 'di skabs dus dbang gis gdung zhugs 'bul kyang mtshan du byed dgos byung stabs srod thun dang po'i dus su sku gdung spyan drangs pa'i tshe shar phyogs nas 'ja' dkar po dar dkar bskyang ba lta bu gdung khang steng du slebs pa yang bla ma dam pa bshad sgrub dpal sogs thugs slob 'ga' zhig gi mig gis bdud rtsir gyur cing / zhal slob nang ma dag gis dus 'bor lha dgu'i sgo nas me mchod phul tshe dri bzang bo'i ngad kyis phyogs kun khyab pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bzang mang du byung /hor zla bdun pa'i gral tshes dge bar gdung khang zhal phyes te 03

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/gdung rus rnams ras dkar gyi snod du btus skabs ngo mtshar ba zhig la ljags dang / gdan gyi dkyil 'khor/ sgal tshigs sku sha dang bcas zhugs kyis ma gos par lhag 'dug cing / sgal tshigs phun tshogs kyis tsha tshwa'i ras zhes pa'i sa der zhugs la sbyangs pa'i tshe shar ri'i spor nas lho ri'i rtse bar 'ja' tshon dkar po zhags pa bskyang ba lta bu'i dge mtshan byung / de nas dgung zhag gi bar rus khrus dang rus sgrub sogs legs par grub rjes nyung shas shig 'jim par bsres nas sku bsnyan btab pa dang / tshon dang na bza' phul te dud tshang re re bzhin rten skal du bkram/ rjes 'jug dad ldan rnams kyis dus dang bstun te thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs pa'i thabs la 'bad cing / sku gdung mchod rten gyi thebs su bla sprul dag gi ḍa ma ru khra ldan dang / gnyug mar gnas pa'i skyes pa bud med rnams kyi ga'u sogs lus chas sna tshogs phul ba de bla ma chul rgyam phun tshogs pad tshul rnams kyis gtsos slob 'bangs yongs nas mthun rkyen gang 'os 'phral du sbyar te/ rin po che'i phra tshoms kyis mdzes pa'i dngul gyi sku gdung chung ba brgyad dang che ba gcig bcas gsar skrun byas te/ legs par grub mtshams mchod rten gyi 104

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzesargyan/bum pa'i nang du mtshungs med 'gro ba'i mgon po mchog gis rjes 'jug dad ldan rnams la dngos grub kyi skal bar bzhag pa'i ljags dang thugs dam 'bral spang gi rten bla ma tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i gdung sku sogs byin rlabs can gyi rten sna mang pos thog drangs reng bsrel rnam bzhi'i zung 'jug gis gtam par byas te/ dus tshes dge ba dang bstun zhal slob nang ma dag gis rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'i sgo nas byin rlabs kyi gter du bsgrubs/ gdung zhugs 'bul gyi sar yang grwa btsun dam pa ngag 'phrin dang skya rgyag zung gis sku gdung byang chub mchod rten thog so gnyis can zhig gsar du bzhengs/thugs rten de dag kyang da lta snyigs 'gro'i bsod nams kyi zhing du byin rlabs kyi gzi brgya 'bar bzhin bzhugs pa 'di lags so/ /de yang mchod rten bskor ba'i phan yon gyi mdo las/ gang zhig bzhugs la mchod pa dang / /mya ngan 'das pa'i sku gdung la/ /sems ni mnyam par dad pa yis/ /bsod nams la ni khyad par med/ /ces dang / spyod 'jug las/ byang chub spyod pa rjes mthun pas/ /rgyal ba'i mchod sdong sgrubs pa yang //byang chub sems dpa' mya ngan las//'das kyang don rnams thams cad mdzad/ /ces dang / thub dgongs 105

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/las/ mnyam par sems rab tu dad pa'i rnam par smin pa mnyam par gsungs so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / smras pa/lnga bdo'i rgud pa shwa 'od bzhin rdol bas/ /bstan 'gro'i legs tshogs 'jom la phyogs pa'i tshe/ /rmad byung snying stobs mchog gis go bgo ba/ /rgyal sras sems dpa' chen po'i ngang tshul lags/ /sngon smon thugs bskyed go las rab drangs pa'i/ /phrin las tsha zer stong gi drwa ba can/ /chos dbyings nub ri'i phag tu 'chel ba na/ /'jig rten mun pa'i gos kyis klub dang mtshungs/ /yid 'ong blta bas mi ngoms dgyes 'dzum zhal/ /mtshar sdug ston zla gsar ba'i dpal 'phrogs kyang / /bcu gnyis mdzad bzang rdzogs pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyis/ /skal dman skye bo'i mig gi yul las 'das/ /kye ma dus mthar bstan dang 'gro ba'i gnyen/ /phan bde ma lus 'byung ba'i sgo gcig pu/ /106

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mdzesargyan/glo bur zhi ba'i dbyings su mnal bas na/ /re ltos 'cha' rnams snying khong chu bzhin grang / /rkyen ngan dug tsher 'khrigs pa'i nags klung du/ /'chor med las nyon rlung gis nyer drangs pa'i/ /sna tshogs sdug bsngal gyis mnar nyam thag rnams/ /ya nga'i gnas su bskyur ba phod lags sam/ /de ltar gdung ba'i yid kyis nyer bskul na/ /rjes chags brtse ba'i spyan gyis legs gzigs nas/ /bdag sogs 'khor ba'i btsun rar tshud pa rnams/ /zhi bsil nges legs mchog tu dbugs dbyung mdzod/ /ces dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rje bya btang ba sangs rgyas rdo rje dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar ba mdo tsam brjod pa sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan dzambu chu bo'i gser gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba las mdzad pa'i tha ma bstan pa dang dgongs rdzogs sogs ji ltar bsgrubs pa'i skabs te drug pa'o/ / 'dir smras pa/dpag yas rgyal ba'i mdzad bzang mtha' dag snying stobs mchog 107

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa 'i mdzesargyan/gis khur bzhes te/ /snyigs ma'i 'gro la sangs rgyas las lhag brtse ba'i skyong bar rlabs chen mthu grub pas/ /'gro khrims la ltos sna tshogs thabs kyis lus can bde la sbyor mdzad pa'i/ /bstan 'gro'i gnyen du bsam bzhin byon pa rigs brgya'i byed po rdo rje 'chang / /gdul bya'i skal ba ji bzhin mdo sngags kyi/ /zab rgyas gdams pa bdud rtsi'i 'od snang gis/ /thar 'dod snying gi mun pa sel mdzad pa'i/ /dam pa'i mgon des byang chub bar du skyongs/ /srid pa'i bde 'byor dug bcas zas bzhin du/ /mthong nas thub pas bsngags pa'i bas mtha' mā /sgrub la gcig tu gzhol ba'i ngang tshul gyis/ /skal ldan yongs kyi 'jug ngogs mtshon par byas/ /cher snyigs dug tsher 'khrigs pa'i nags khrod 'dir/ / mi bzad bskal gsum bdo ba'i sbrul gdugs kyis/ /yang yang nyen pa'i mgon med skye bo'i tshogs/ / tshophan bde'i dbugs 'byin mkha' lding khyod min su/ /108

rnam par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i rme jes rgyan/dus bab 'gro la myong grol bdud rtsi'i gter/ /nam yang gtan pa med pa'i sgo phyes pas/ /nad gdon nyer 'tshe'i g.yul ngo pham byas te/ /zad med bde dga'i dpal la mgron du bsus/ /gsang gsum yon tan mtha' bral yid bzhin mtsho/ /blo chung byis pa'i rkyal gyis gzhal min yang / /tshig don cha tsam myang ba re res kyang / /gtan bde'i gnas la phyogs pa'i spro ba 'dzin/ /de ltar brjod pa'i tshig gi spros pa kun/ /dbyangs can rig par drangs pa'i mthu med kyang / /cha tsam spel ba'i gser gyi phreng ba 'di/ /mgon khyod mnyes byed mchod pa'i sprin du bstar/ /'di las 'ongs pa'i rnam dkar zegs ma'i chas/ /mtshon te rang gzhan dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs/ /kun bzang smon pa'i chu klung dang 'grogs nas/ /mthar thug sku bzhi'i rgya mtshor 'bab par shog /109

mem par thar ba sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mjes rgyan tshe sgo bas phreng bar rje bcun bla ma yi/ /gzhan phan rgyal sras spyod pa'i rjes zhugs te/ /nam mkha' ji srid mar gyur 'gro ba kun/ /phan bde'i dasnyegs 'byin chen po bdag gyur cig /ces rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rje bya btang ba sangs rgyas rdo rje dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar ba mdo tsam brjod pa sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan dzasbu chu bo'i gser gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dgon 'di'i rdo rje slob dpon bla ma e mgon mchog nas gnang skyes dang bcas bka'i me tog 'thor ba dang / de marlungs mabo/na lngardzo gang gi zhabs 'degs tshul bzhin sgrub pa la lhag bsam mi dman pa'i bla ma dam pa phun tshogs nyid kyis sa bon 'tshol bsdu byas thog sgor lnga brgya dar che legs dang bcas myur rtsom dgos pa'i bskul ma yang yang mdzad cing / gzhan yang sku tsha dam pa nor bu 'od zer nas kyang skyes dang bcas te de bzhin bskul ba dang / nye char mgon po gang gi yang sprul dam pa thub dbang rdo rje mchog gis rogs phan gang drag mdzad pa dang / rang nyid kyis kyang rnam thar cha rdohā ba'i phyir phyogs so so'i rgyus yod dag la dri rmed byas pa sogs
